records.literal_gloss: And gathered again David every chosen [man] in Israel, thirty thousand.

en.L: And David again gathered every chosen [man] in Israel, thirty thousand.
en.B: David again gathered all the chosen men of Israel, thirty thousand.
en.R: Once more David called together the best fighting men in Israel, thirty thousand of them.

es.L: Y volvió David a reunir a todos los escogidos de Israel, treinta mil.
es.B: David volvió a reunir a todos los hombres escogidos de Israel, treinta mil.
es.R: Una vez más David reunió a los mejores guerreros de Israel, treinta mil en total.

fr.L: Et David rassembla encore toute l’élite d’Israël, trente mille [hommes].
fr.B: David rassembla de nouveau tous les hommes d’élite d’Israël, au nombre de trente mille.
fr.R: Une fois de plus, David a réuni les meilleurs combattants d’Israël, trente mille hommes.

sw.L: Daudi akawakusanya tena kila [mtu] aliyechaguliwa katika Israeli, elfu thelathini.
sw.B: Daudi aliwakusanya tena watu wote wateule wa Israeli, elfu thelathini.
sw.R: Kwa mara nyingine Daudi aliwaita pamoja wapiganaji bora wa Israeli, watu elfu thelathini.

vi.L: Đa-vít lại tập hợp tất cả những người tinh nhuệ trong Y-sơ-ra-ên, ba mươi nghìn người.
vi.B: Đa-vít lại tập hợp tất cả những người tinh nhuệ của Y-sơ-ra-ên, ba mươi nghìn người.
vi.R: Một lần nữa Đa-vít triệu tập những chiến binh giỏi nhất trong Y-sơ-ra-ên, tổng cộng ba mươi nghìn người.

ko.L: 그리고 다윗이 다시 이스라엘에서 뽑힌 [사람을] 모두 모았는데, 삼만 명이었다.
ko.B: 다윗은 다시 이스라엘에서 뽑힌 사람들을 모두 모았는데, 그 수가 삼만 명이었다.
ko.R: 다윗은 또다시 이스라엘에서 가장 뛰어난 군인들을 불러 모았다. 모두 삼만 명이었다.

pt.L: E Davi reuniu ainda outra vez todos os escolhidos em Israel, trinta mil.
pt.B: Davi reuniu de novo todos os homens escolhidos de Israel, trinta mil.
pt.R: Mais uma vez Davi convocou os melhores guerreiros de Israel, trinta mil homens.

decisions.choice: gathered again: called together once more
decisions.reason: The verb means "gather, assemble". With "again" it looks back to the times David had already brought Israel together: when the tribes came to make him king (5:1-3) and when he led them against the Philistines (5:17-25). Now he gathers them for a new purpose, to bring the ark to his city.

decisions.choice: every chosen man in Israel: picked men in their prime
decisions.reason: The word means "chosen" and is used of young men at their strongest and of picked troops (1 Samuel 24:3; 26:2). The escort for the ark is gathered like an army, as the ark had once gone out with Israel's army (1 Samuel 4:3-4).

decisions.choice: thirty thousand: the number as written
decisions.reason: The word for "thousand" can also name a unit of troops, which would make the company smaller; see the note at Numbers 1. Here it is given as a number.

decisions.choice: the best fighting men
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly who the "chosen" men were: the picked men of Israel's fighting force.

source.text: וַיָּ֣קָם׀וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֗ד וְכָל־הָעָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתּ֔וֹ מִֽבַּעֲלֵ֖י יְהוּדָ֑ה לְהַעֲל֣וֹת מִשָּׁ֗ם אֵ֚ת אֲר֣וֹן הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר־נִקְרָ֣א שֵׁ֗ם שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֧ה צְבָא֛וֹת יֹשֵׁ֥ב הַכְּרֻבִ֖ים עָלָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And arose and went David and all the people who [were] with him from Baale-judah to bring up from there [the] ark of the God, which is called [the] name, [the] name of Yahweh of hosts, sitting [on] the cherubim over it.

en.L: And David arose and went, and all the people who [were] with him, from Baale-judah, to bring up from there the ark of God, which is called by the name, the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts, who sits [on] the cherubim over it.
en.B: Then David and all the people with him set out from Baale-judah to bring the ark of God up from there, the ark which is called by the name, the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies, who sits enthroned on the cherubim above it.
en.R: Then David and all the people with him went from Baale-judah to bring the ark of God up from there. The ark bears the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies. He sits as king above the cherubim, the winged creatures on the lid of the ark.

es.L: Y se levantó David y fue, con todo el pueblo que [estaba] con él, desde Baale de Judá, para subir de allí el arca de Dios, que es llamada por el nombre, el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} de los ejércitos, que se sienta [sobre] los querubines encima de ella.
es.B: Entonces David y todo el pueblo que lo acompañaba partieron de Baale de Judá para subir de allí el arca de Dios, el arca que es llamada por el nombre, el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos, que tiene su trono sobre los querubines encima de ella.
es.R: Entonces David y todo el pueblo que estaba con él fueron desde Baale de Judá para subir de allí el arca de Dios. El arca lleva el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos. Él reina sentado sobre los querubines, los seres alados que están sobre la tapa del arca.

fr.L: Et David se leva et partit, avec tout le peuple qui [était] avec lui, de Baalé-Juda, pour faire monter de là l’arche de Dieu, sur laquelle est invoqué le nom, le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} des armées, qui siège [sur] les chérubins au-dessus d’elle.
fr.B: Puis David et tout le peuple qui l’accompagnait partirent de Baalé-Juda pour faire monter de là l’arche de Dieu, l’arche qui porte le nom, le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} des armées, qui siège sur son trône au-dessus des chérubins.
fr.R: Ensuite David et tout le peuple qui était avec lui sont partis de Baalé-Juda pour faire monter de là l’arche de Dieu. L’arche porte le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} des armées. Il siège comme roi au-dessus des chérubins, les êtres ailés qui sont sur le couvercle de l’arche.

sw.L: Daudi akainuka akaenda, na watu wote waliokuwa pamoja naye, kutoka Baale-yuda, ili kulipandisha kutoka huko sanduku la Mungu, linaloitwa kwa jina, jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, aketiye [juu ya] makerubi juu yake.
sw.B: Kisha Daudi na watu wote waliokuwa pamoja naye waliondoka Baale-yuda ili kulipandisha kutoka huko sanduku la Mungu, sanduku linaloitwa kwa jina, jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi, anayeketi katika enzi juu ya makerubi yaliyo juu yake.
sw.R: Kisha Daudi na watu wote waliokuwa pamoja naye walikwenda kutoka Baale-yuda ili kulileta sanduku la Mungu kutoka huko. Sanduku hilo linaitwa kwa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi. Yeye huketi kama mfalme juu ya makerubi, viumbe wenye mabawa walio juu ya kifuniko cha sanduku.

vi.L: Đa-vít đứng dậy cùng toàn dân ở với ông ra đi từ Ba-a-lê Giu-đa, để đem hòm của Đức Chúa Trời từ đó lên, là hòm được gọi bằng danh, danh của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, Đấng ngự [trên] các chê-ru-bim ở trên hòm.
vi.B: Bấy giờ Đa-vít cùng toàn dân ở với ông lên đường từ Ba-a-lê Giu-đa để rước hòm của Đức Chúa Trời từ đó lên. Hòm ấy được gọi bằng danh, chính danh của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân, Đấng ngự trên các chê-ru-bim ở trên hòm.
vi.R: Rồi Đa-vít cùng toàn dân ở với ông đi từ Ba-a-lê Giu-đa để rước hòm của Đức Chúa Trời từ đó lên. Hòm ấy mang danh của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân. Ngài ngự như vua ở trên các chê-ru-bim, là những vật có cánh trên nắp hòm.

ko.L: 그리고 다윗과 그와 함께 [있던] 모든 백성이 일어나 바알레유다에서 떠나, 거기에서 하나님의 궤를 올려 오려고 했다. 그 궤는 그 위의 그룹들 위에 앉아 계시는 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름, 바로 그 이름으로 불린다.
ko.B: 그때 다윗과 그와 함께 있던 모든 백성이 바알레유다를 떠나, 거기에서 하나님의 궤를 올려 오려고 했다. 그 궤는 그 위의 그룹들 위에 앉아 다스리시는 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름으로 불리는 궤였다.
ko.R: 다윗과 그와 함께 있던 모든 사람은 바알레유다에서 하나님의 궤를 올려 오려고 떠났다. 그 궤에는 하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름이 붙어 있었다. 그분은 그룹들 위에 왕으로 앉아 계신다. 그룹들은 궤 뚜껑 위에 있는 날개 달린 존재들이다.

pt.L: E Davi se levantou e foi, e todo o povo que [estava] com ele, de Baalá de Judá, para fazer subir dali a arca de Deus, que é chamada pelo nome, o nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} dos Exércitos, que se assenta [sobre] os querubins acima dela.
pt.B: Então Davi e todo o povo que estava com ele partiram de Baalá de Judá para levar dali para cima a arca de Deus, a arca que é chamada pelo nome, o nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} dos Exércitos, que está entronizado sobre os querubins acima dela.
pt.R: Então Davi e todo o povo que estava com ele saíram de Baalá de Judá para levar dali para cima a arca de Deus. A arca leva o nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} dos Exércitos. Ele se assenta como rei acima dos querubins, as criaturas com asas que ficavam sobre a tampa da arca.

decisions.choice: Baale-judah: another name for Kiriath-jearim
decisions.reason: Baale-judah means "the Baalahs of Judah"; the name may also be read as "Baalah of Judah". Joshua 15:9 says "Baalah, that is, Kiriath-jearim", and 1 Chronicles 13:6 tells this story with both names. The ark had stayed there in the house of Abinadab ever since the Philistines sent it back (1 Samuel 7:1-2).

decisions.choice: from Baale-judah: as the Hebrew text reads
alternatives: went to Baale-judah, to bring up from there the ark (as 1 Chronicles 13:6)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says David went "from" Baale-judah "to bring up from there" the ark. Read as it stands, the story begins as the company leaves the town with the ark. The same story in 1 Chronicles 13:6 says David went up "to" Baalah, and a slip of one letter in copying could explain the difference here. The place is the same either way; only the starting point of the journey differs.

decisions.choice: which is called by the name, the name of the LORD: the ark bears the LORD's own name
alternatives: which is called by the name of the LORD of hosts (the word once)
where the name of the LORD of hosts is called on
decisions.reason: To have someone's name called over a thing means that it belongs to him (Deuteronomy 28:10; Jeremiah 7:10-11; 1 Kings 8:43). The Hebrew writes the word "name" twice. This may be for emphasis, "the name, the very name", or a copyist may have written the word twice; 1 Chronicles 13:6 and the Greek have it once. The meaning is the same either way.

decisions.choice: the LORD of hosts who sits enthroned on the cherubim: the same title as at the ark's loss
decisions.reason: This is the title given to the ark when it was carried out of Shiloh into the battle where it was captured (1 Samuel 4:4). Now, as the ark is brought up to David's city, the writer gives the full title again. The differences: in 1 Samuel 4:4 it is "the ark of the covenant of the LORD of hosts", while here it is "the ark of God" that is called by the LORD's name; and here the cherubim are "over it", on the ark's cover (Exodus 25:18-22).

decisions.choice: sits: sits enthroned, reigns
decisions.reason: As in 1 Samuel 4:4, the verb "sit" said of a king means to sit on a throne. The LORD is pictured as king seated above the cherubim, with the ark as his footstool (1 Chronicles 28:2; Psalm 99:1).

decisions.choice: all the people who were with him: the chosen men of verse 1
decisions.reason: "The people" here are the men David had gathered (verse 1), though by verse 5 all Israel has joined the celebration.

decisions.choice: the LORD of Armies
decisions.reason: As everywhere in these books, Balanced and Readable say "Armies" for "hosts", the plainer word for what the title means; Literal keeps "hosts".

decisions.choice: The ark bears the name of ...; He sits as king above the cherubim, the winged creatures on the lid of the ark
decisions.reason: Readable says once that the ark bears the LORD's name rather than repeating "name", and explains the cherubim in the words used at 1 Samuel 4:4, in a new sentence.

decisions.choice: le SEIGNEUR des armées (every level); l'arche de Dieu
decisions.reason: For the whole of 2 Samuel, as the Samuel and Psalms terms notes set: "le SEIGNEUR des armées" at every level, the span covering "du SEIGNEUR" only. "L'arche de Dieu" and "l'arche du SEIGNEUR" follow the terms note.

decisions.choice: "el arca de Dios"; "el SEÑOR de los ejércitos" (L), "de los Ejércitos" (B, R); "los querubines"
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note and the Pentateuch list set: "el arca de Dios / del SEÑOR", "los querubines", and tseba'ot as "de los ejércitos" at Literal and "de los Ejércitos" at Balanced and Readable, for the whole of 2 Samuel. The divine name span stays on "del SEÑOR" alone.

decisions.choice: sanduku la Mungu; BWANA wa majeshi
decisions.reason: As set for Samuel in Swahili: "sanduku la Mungu / la BWANA / la agano" for the ark, and "BWANA wa majeshi" at every level for "the LORD of hosts" (English Balanced and Readable "of Armies"). "Makerubi" for the cherubim, as in the Pentateuch.

decisions.choice: "hòm của Đức Chúa Trời"; "CHÚA Vạn Quân", with the divine_name span on CHÚA only
decisions.reason: The Samuel terms note's forms for the ark and for "the LORD of hosts", used through these chapters.

decisions.choice: "chê-ru-bim" (R adds "là những vật có cánh trên nắp hòm")
decisions.reason: The cherubim are named as the tradition does; Readable says what they were, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}" (L, B); "하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}" (R)
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note sets for *YHWH tsebaʾot*.

decisions.choice: "하나님의 궤" for the ark of God, "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤" for the ark of the LORD
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note; the Hebrew's two names for the ark are kept apart at every level.

decisions.choice: Baalá de Judá
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the town is the "Baalá" that Joshua 15:9 in Portuguese names as Quiriate-Jearim (m1), where the ark had stayed in Abinadabe's house (1 Samuel 7:1); Portuguese keeps that form so the reader can recognise the place, where the English gives the Hebrew plural "Baale".

decisions.choice: a arca de Deus; o SENHOR dos Exércitos (every level)
decisions.reason: The book-wide terms of 1 Samuel in Portuguese: "a arca de Deus" where the Hebrew says "the ark of God", and "Exércitos" at every level, where the English Literal keeps "hosts". The title and Readable's explanation of the cherubim keep the words of 1 Samuel 4:4 in Portuguese (m4).

source.text: וַיַּרְכִּ֜בוּ אֶת־אֲר֤וֹן הָֽאֱלֹהִים֙ אֶל־עֲגָלָ֣ה חֲדָשָׁ֔ה וַיִּשָּׂאֻ֔הוּ מִבֵּ֥ית אֲבִינָדָ֖ב אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּגִּבְעָ֑ה וְעֻזָּ֣א וְאַחְי֗וֹ בְּנֵי֙ אֲבִ֣ינָדָ֔ב נֹהֲגִ֖ים אֶת־הָעֲגָלָ֥ה חֲדָשָֽׁה׃

records.literal_gloss: And they made ride [the] ark of the God on [a] cart new, and they carried it from [the] house of Abinadab which [was] on the hill; and Uzzah and Ahio, [the] sons of Abinadab, [were] driving the cart new.

en.L: And they set the ark of God on a new cart and carried it from the house of Abinadab, which [was] on the hill; and Uzzah and Ahio, the sons of Abinadab, [were] driving the new cart.
en.B: They placed the ark of God on a new cart and took it away from Abinadab's house on the hill, while Uzzah and Ahio, the sons of Abinadab, drove the new cart.
en.R: They put the ark of God on a new cart and took it from Abinadab's house on the hill. Abinadab's sons Uzzah and Ahio were guiding the cart.

es.L: Y pusieron el arca de Dios sobre un carro nuevo y la llevaron de la casa de Abinadab, que [estaba] en la colina; y Uza y Ahío, los hijos de Abinadab, [guiaban] el carro nuevo.
es.B: Colocaron el arca de Dios sobre un carro nuevo y se la llevaron de la casa de Abinadab, en la colina, mientras Uza y Ahío, hijos de Abinadab, conducían el carro nuevo.
es.R: Pusieron el arca de Dios sobre un carro nuevo y la sacaron de la casa de Abinadab, que estaba en la colina. Uza y Ahío, los hijos de Abinadab, guiaban el carro.

fr.L: Et ils firent monter l’arche de Dieu sur un chariot neuf et l’emportèrent de la maison d’Abinadab, qui [était] sur la colline ; et Ouzza et Ahio, les fils d’Abinadab, conduisaient le chariot neuf.
fr.B: Ils placèrent l’arche de Dieu sur un chariot neuf et l’emmenèrent de la maison d’Abinadab, sur la colline. Ouzza et Ahio, les fils d’Abinadab, conduisaient le chariot neuf.
fr.R: Ils ont mis l’arche de Dieu sur un chariot neuf et ils l’ont emportée de la maison d’Abinadab, sur la colline. Les fils d’Abinadab, Ouzza et Ahio, guidaient le chariot.

sw.L: Wakalipandisha sanduku la Mungu juu ya gari jipya, wakalichukua kutoka nyumba ya Abinadabu, [iliyokuwa] kilimani; na Uza na Ahio, wana wa Abinadabu, [walikuwa] wakiliendesha gari jipya.
sw.B: Waliliweka sanduku la Mungu juu ya gari jipya la kukokotwa, wakalitoa nyumbani kwa Abinadabu kilimani, huku Uza na Ahio, wana wa Abinadabu, wakiliendesha gari hilo jipya.
sw.R: Waliliweka sanduku la Mungu juu ya gari jipya la kukokotwa, wakalitoa nyumbani kwa Abinadabu kilimani. Wana wa Abinadabu, Uza na Ahio, waliliongoza gari hilo.

vi.L: Họ đặt hòm của Đức Chúa Trời lên một cỗ xe mới và chở đi từ nhà A-bi-na-đáp ở trên đồi; U-xa và A-hi-ô, các con trai của A-bi-na-đáp, đánh cỗ xe mới.
vi.B: Họ đặt hòm của Đức Chúa Trời lên một cỗ xe mới và chở đi khỏi nhà A-bi-na-đáp trên đồi; U-xa và A-hi-ô, con trai A-bi-na-đáp, đánh cỗ xe mới ấy.
vi.R: Họ đặt hòm của Đức Chúa Trời lên một cỗ xe mới và chở đi từ nhà A-bi-na-đáp trên đồi. Hai con trai của A-bi-na-đáp là U-xa và A-hi-ô điều khiển xe.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 하나님의 궤를 새 수레에 싣고 언덕 위에 [있는] 아비나답의 집에서 그것을 가져왔다. 그리고 아비나답의 아들들 웃사와 아히오가 그 새 수레를 몰고 [있었다].
ko.B: 그들은 하나님의 궤를 새 수레에 싣고 언덕 위에 있는 아비나답의 집에서 가지고 나왔다. 아비나답의 아들 웃사와 아히오가 그 새 수레를 몰았다.
ko.R: 그들은 하나님의 궤를 새 수레에 싣고 언덕 위에 있는 아비나답의 집에서 가지고 나왔다. 아비나답의 아들 웃사와 아히오가 수레를 몰았다.

pt.L: E puseram a arca de Deus sobre uma carroça nova e a levaram da casa de Abinadabe, que [estava] na colina; e Uzá e Aiô, os filhos de Abinadabe, conduziam a carroça nova.
pt.B: Eles colocaram a arca de Deus sobre uma carroça nova e a levaram da casa de Abinadabe, na colina, enquanto Uzá e Aiô, filhos de Abinadabe, conduziam a carroça nova.
pt.R: Eles puseram a arca de Deus numa carroça nova e a tiraram da casa de Abinadabe, na colina. Uzá e Aiô, filhos de Abinadabe, iam guiando a carroça.

decisions.choice: set on a new cart: carried by oxen instead of on men's shoulders
decisions.reason: A new cart, never used for ordinary work, was a mark of respect. But it was how the Philistines had sent the ark back (1 Samuel 6:7-8). The law gave the holy things to the Levites of Kohath to carry on their shoulders with poles (Exodus 25:14; Numbers 4:15; 7:9). When David tried again, the ark was carried (verse 13), and 1 Chronicles 15:13-15 says the first attempt failed because this was not done.

decisions.choice: on the hill: a hill at Kiriath-jearim
decisions.reason: As in 1 Samuel 7:1, which uses the same words. The word can also be the name of the town Gibeah, but here it points to the high ground where Abinadab's house stood.

decisions.choice: Uzzah and Ahio, the sons of Abinadab: his sons or his descendants
decisions.reason: The ark had come to Abinadab's house at least twenty years before Saul's reign (1 Samuel 7:2), so these men may be his grandsons; "sons" can cover later generations. The letters of the name Ahio can also be read "his brother", and the Greek has "his brothers", but the name fits verse 4, where he walks ahead of the ark.

decisions.choice: guiding the cart
decisions.reason: The verb is used of leading or driving animals. Readable says "guiding", since the men walked beside the oxen and steered them.

decisions.choice: gari la kukokotwa
decisions.reason: "Gari" alone is now a motor car, so Balanced and Readable say "gari la kukokotwa" (a cart drawn by animals); Literal keeps "gari".

decisions.choice: "A-bi-na-đáp", "U-xa", "A-hi-ô"
decisions.reason: Names not in the terms note's table, in the usual Protestant forms; so too "Na-côn", "Phê-rết U-xa" and "Ô-bết Ê-đôm" below.

decisions.choice: Abinadabe; Uzá; Aiô; uma carroça nova
decisions.reason: For the whole book: "Abinadabe" and "na colina" as 1 Samuel 7:1 in Portuguese; "Uzá" and "Aiô" are the usual Brazilian forms, with the accents Portuguese needs for the stress. "Carroça nova" keeps the words of 1 Samuel 6:7 in Portuguese, the Philistines' cart that m1 recalls.

source.text: וַיִּשָּׂאֻ֗הוּ מִבֵּ֤ית אֲבִֽינָדָב֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּגִּבְעָ֔ה עִ֖ם אֲר֣וֹן הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְאַחְי֕וֹ הֹלֵ֖ךְ לִפְנֵ֥י הָאָרֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: and they carried it from [the] house of Abinadab which [was] on the hill with [the] ark of the God; and Ahio [was] walking before the ark.

en.L: And they carried it from the house of Abinadab, which [was] on the hill, with the ark of God; and Ahio [was] walking before the ark.
en.B: So they brought the cart out of the house of Abinadab on the hill with the ark of God on it, and Ahio was walking in front of the ark.
en.R: They brought the cart out of Abinadab's house with the ark of God on it. Ahio walked in front of the ark.

es.R: Sacaron el carro de la casa de Abinadab con el arca de Dios encima. Ahío iba delante del arca.

fr.L: Et ils l’emportèrent de la maison d’Abinadab, qui [était] sur la colline, avec l’arche de Dieu ; et Ahio marchait devant l’arche.
fr.B: Ils sortirent donc le chariot de la maison d’Abinadab, sur la colline, avec l’arche de Dieu dessus, et Ahio marchait devant l’arche.
fr.R: Ils ont sorti le chariot de la maison d’Abinadab avec l’arche de Dieu dessus. Ahio marchait devant l’arche.

sw.L: Wakalichukua kutoka nyumba ya Abinadabu, [iliyokuwa] kilimani, pamoja na sanduku la Mungu; na Ahio [alikuwa] akitembea mbele ya sanduku.

sw.R: Walilitoa gari hilo nyumbani kwa Abinadabu likiwa na sanduku la Mungu juu yake. Ahio alitembea mbele ya sanduku.

vi.L: Họ chở nó đi từ nhà A-bi-na-đáp ở trên đồi, cùng với hòm của Đức Chúa Trời; A-hi-ô đi trước hòm.
vi.B: Vậy họ đưa cỗ xe chở hòm của Đức Chúa Trời ra khỏi nhà A-bi-na-đáp trên đồi, và A-hi-ô đi phía trước hòm.
vi.R: Họ đưa cỗ xe chở hòm của Đức Chúa Trời ra khỏi nhà A-bi-na-đáp. A-hi-ô đi phía trước hòm.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 하나님의 궤와 함께 그것을 언덕 위에 [있는] 아비나답의 집에서 가져왔다. 그리고 아히오는 궤 앞에서 걸어가고 [있었다].
ko.B: 그들은 하나님의 궤를 실은 수레를 언덕 위에 있는 아비나답의 집에서 끌고 나왔다. 아히오는 궤 앞에서 걸어갔다.
ko.R: 그들은 하나님의 궤를 실은 수레를 아비나답의 집에서 끌고 나왔다. 아히오는 궤 앞에서 걸어갔다.

pt.L: E a levaram da casa de Abinadabe, que [estava] na colina, com a arca de Deus; e Aiô ia diante da arca.
pt.B: Assim tiraram a carroça da casa de Abinadabe, na colina, com a arca de Deus sobre ela, e Aiô ia à frente da arca.
pt.R: Eles tiraram a carroça da casa de Abinadabe com a arca de Deus em cima dela. Aiô ia andando na frente da arca.

decisions.choice: the Hebrew text as it stands, repeating words from verse 3
alternatives: omit the repeated words and read only "with the ark of God, and Ahio was walking before the ark"
decisions.reason: The first words of this verse repeat the end of verse 3 almost word for word. A copyist's eye probably slipped back to the same words, and the Greek has a shorter text; 1 Chronicles 13:7 has neither. Read as it stands, "it" is the new cart, and "with the ark of God" says what it was carrying.

decisions.choice: Ahio walking before the ark: leading the oxen
decisions.reason: Ahio walked ahead to lead the team, while Uzzah stayed by the cart, close enough to reach the ark when the oxen stumbled (verse 6).

decisions.choice: the cart ... with the ark of God on it
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the cart, which "it" refers to, and add "on it" so that "with the ark of God" reads as what the cart carried.

source.text: וְדָוִ֣ד׀וְכָל־בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל מְשַֽׂחֲקִים֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה בְּכֹ֖ל עֲצֵ֣י בְרוֹשִׁ֑ים וּבְכִנֹּר֤וֹת וּבִנְבָלִים֙ וּבְתֻפִּ֔ים וּבִמְנַֽעַנְעִ֖ים וּֽבְצֶלְצֶלִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And David and all [the] house of Israel [were] celebrating before Yahweh with all woods of cypresses, and with lyres and with harps and with tambourines and with rattles and with cymbals.

en.L: And David and all the house of Israel [were] celebrating before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} with all [kinds of] cypress wood, and with lyres and with harps and with tambourines and with rattles and with cymbals.
en.B: David and the whole house of Israel were celebrating before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} with every kind of instrument made of cypress wood, with lyres, harps, tambourines, rattles and cymbals.
en.R: David and all the people of Israel were celebrating in front of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. They played all kinds of instruments made of cypress wood, and lyres, harps, tambourines, rattles and cymbals.

es.L: Y David y toda la casa de Israel [se regocijaban] delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} con toda [clase de instrumentos de] madera de ciprés, y con liras y con arpas y con panderos y con sonajas y con címbalos.
es.B: David y toda la casa de Israel celebraban delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} con toda clase de instrumentos de madera de ciprés, con liras, arpas, panderos, sonajas y címbalos.
es.R: David y todo el pueblo de Israel celebraban delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Tocaban toda clase de instrumentos hechos de madera de ciprés, y liras, arpas, panderos, sonajas y címbalos.

fr.L: Et David et toute la maison d’Israël s’égayaient devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avec toutes [sortes de] bois de cyprès, et avec des lyres, et avec des harpes, et avec des tambourins, et avec des sistres, et avec des cymbales.
fr.B: David et toute la maison d’Israël se réjouissaient devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avec toutes sortes d’instruments en bois de cyprès, avec des lyres, des harpes, des tambourins, des sistres et des cymbales.
fr.R: David et tout le peuple d’Israël faisaient la fête devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Ils jouaient de toutes sortes d’instruments en bois de cyprès, et aussi de la lyre, de la harpe, du tambourin, des sistres et des cymbales.

sw.L: Daudi na nyumba yote ya Israeli [walikuwa] wakishangilia mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa [aina] zote za miti ya mivinje, na kwa vinubi na kwa zeze na kwa matari na kwa njuga na kwa matoazi.
sw.B: Daudi na nyumba yote ya Israeli walikuwa wakishangilia mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa kila aina ya vyombo vya muziki vilivyotengenezwa kwa mti wa mvinje, kwa vinubi, zeze, matari, njuga na matoazi.
sw.R: Daudi na watu wote wa Israeli walikuwa wakishangilia mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Walipiga kila aina ya vyombo vya muziki vilivyotengenezwa kwa mti wa mvinje, na vinubi, zeze, matari, njuga na matoazi.

vi.L: Đa-vít và cả nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên nhảy múa vui mừng trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} với đủ [loại nhạc cụ bằng] gỗ bách, với đàn lia, đàn hạc, trống cơm, lục lạc và chập chõa.
vi.B: Đa-vít và cả nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên hân hoan nhảy múa trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} với đủ loại nhạc cụ bằng gỗ bách, với đàn lia, đàn hạc, trống cơm, lục lạc và chập chõa.
vi.R: Đa-vít và toàn dân Y-sơ-ra-ên vui mừng nhảy múa trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Họ chơi đủ loại nhạc cụ làm bằng gỗ bách, cùng với đàn lia, đàn hạc, trống cơm, lục lạc và chập chõa.

ko.L: 그리고 다윗과 이스라엘 온 집이 잣나무로 [만든] 온갖 [악기]와 수금과 비파와 소고와 방울과 심벌즈로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 즐거워하고 [있었다].
ko.B: 다윗과 이스라엘 온 집안은 잣나무로 만든 온갖 악기와 수금과 비파와 소고와 방울과 심벌즈를 연주하며 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 기뻐 뛰놀았다.
ko.R: 다윗과 이스라엘 모든 백성은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 즐거워했다. 그들은 잣나무로 만든 온갖 악기와 수금과 비파와 소고와 방울과 심벌즈를 연주했다.

pt.L: E Davi e toda a casa de Israel celebravam diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} com toda [sorte de] madeira de cipreste, e com liras, e com harpas, e com tamborins, e com chocalhos, e com címbalos.
pt.B: Davi e toda a casa de Israel celebravam diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} com toda espécie de instrumentos de madeira de cipreste, com liras, harpas, tamborins, chocalhos e címbalos.
pt.R: Davi e todo o povo de Israel faziam festa diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. Tocavam todo tipo de instrumentos feitos de madeira de cipreste, e também liras, harpas, tamborins, chocalhos e címbalos.

decisions.choice: celebrating: making merry with music and dance
decisions.reason: The verb means "laugh, play, make merry". It is used of women singing and dancing to welcome the victors (1 Samuel 18:7) and of dancing in celebration (Jeremiah 31:4). David uses the same verb when he answers Michal (verse 21).

decisions.choice: before the LORD: in front of the ark, where the LORD was present
decisions.reason: The ark was the place of the LORD's presence (verse 2), so to celebrate before the ark was to celebrate before the LORD himself (also verses 14, 16, 21).

decisions.choice: with all kinds of cypress wood: instruments made of the wood, as the Hebrew text reads
alternatives: with all their might and with songs (1 Chronicles 13:8; the Greek)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew of Samuel reads "with all woods of cypresses", which most naturally means wooden instruments. 1 Chronicles 13:8, telling the same event, reads "with all their might and with songs", and so does the Greek of Samuel. In Hebrew the two readings are written with many of the same letters, so one may have come from the other in copying.

decisions.choice: lyres, harps, tambourines, rattles and cymbals
decisions.reason: The lyre was the small stringed instrument David played (1 Samuel 16:23); the harp was a larger stringed instrument. The tambourine was a hand drum. The word for "rattles" is found only here and comes from a verb meaning "shake"; it was probably a sistrum, a frame with loose rings that jingle. Cymbals were struck metal plates.

decisions.choice: all the people of Israel
decisions.reason: Readable says "the people of Israel" for "the house of Israel", the whole nation.

decisions.choice: des sistres
decisions.reason: The instrument was shaken to rattle (m4). French "sistre" names the ancient shaken rattle; "crécelle" is a different, whirled noisemaker.

decisions.choice: "đàn lia, đàn hạc, trống cơm, lục lạc và chập chõa"
decisions.reason: Everyday Vietnamese names for the instruments (meaning decision), rather than the older "cầm" and "sắt" few readers know.

decisions.choice: "수금, 비파, 소고, 방울, 심벌즈" for the five instruments; "잣나무" for the wood
decisions.reason: The traditional Korean names for the stringed instruments and the drum are kept; "심벌즈" is today's word. The tree (*berosh*) is uncertain, cypress or juniper; Korean follows the English.

decisions.choice: liras, harpas, tamborins, chocalhos, címbalos
decisions.reason: The instruments keep the words of 1 Samuel 10:5 and 16:16 in Portuguese ("lira", "harpa", "tamborim"); "chocalhos" says what the rare word probably was (m4) in an everyday word, as the English "rattles" does, and "címbalos" names the metal instruments struck together.

source.text: וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ עַד־גֹּ֣רֶן נָכ֑וֹן וַיִּשְׁלַ֨ח עֻזָּ֜א אֶל־אֲר֤וֹן הָֽאֱלֹהִים֙ וַיֹּ֣אחֶז בּ֔וֹ כִּ֥י שָׁמְט֖וּ הַבָּקָֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And they came to [the] threshing floor of Nacon, and sent Uzzah to [the] ark of the God and took hold of it, for stumbled the oxen.

en.L: And they came to the threshing floor of Nacon, and Uzzah reached out to the ark of God and took hold of it, for the oxen stumbled.
en.B: When they arrived at the threshing floor of Nacon, Uzzah put out his hand and took hold of the ark of God, for the oxen had stumbled.
en.R: When they reached the threshing floor of Nacon, the oxen stumbled. Uzzah reached out his hand and grabbed the ark of God to steady it.

es.L: Y llegaron a la era de Nacón, y Uza extendió [la mano] hacia el arca de Dios y la sostuvo, porque los bueyes tropezaron.
es.B: Cuando llegaron a la era de Nacón, Uza extendió la mano y sostuvo el arca de Dios, porque los bueyes habían tropezado.
es.R: Cuando llegaron a la era de Nacón, los bueyes tropezaron. Uza extendió la mano y agarró el arca de Dios para que no se cayera.

fr.L: Et ils arrivèrent à l’aire de Nakôn, et Ouzza étendit [la main] vers l’arche de Dieu et la saisit, car les bœufs avaient bronché.
fr.B: Quand ils arrivèrent à l’aire de Nakôn, Ouzza tendit la main vers l’arche de Dieu et la saisit, car les bœufs avaient trébuché.
fr.R: Quand ils sont arrivés à l’aire de Nakôn, les bœufs ont trébuché. Ouzza a tendu la main et il a attrapé l’arche de Dieu pour la retenir.

sw.L: Wakafika kwenye uwanja wa kupuria wa Nakoni, naye Uza akanyosha [mkono] kwa sanduku la Mungu akalishika, kwa maana ng'ombe walijikwaa.
sw.B: Walipofika kwenye uwanja wa kupuria wa Nakoni, Uza alinyosha mkono wake akalishika sanduku la Mungu, kwa sababu ng'ombe walikuwa wamejikwaa.
sw.R: Walipofika kwenye uwanja wa kupuria wa Nakoni, ng'ombe walijikwaa. Uza akanyosha mkono wake akalishika sanduku la Mungu ili lisianguke.

vi.L: Khi họ đến sân đập lúa Na-côn, U-xa đưa [tay] ra nắm lấy hòm của Đức Chúa Trời, vì bò trượt chân.
vi.B: Khi đến sân đập lúa Na-côn, U-xa đưa tay ra nắm lấy hòm của Đức Chúa Trời, vì đàn bò bị trượt chân.
vi.R: Khi họ đến sân đập lúa Na-côn thì đàn bò bị trượt chân. U-xa đưa tay ra nắm lấy hòm của Đức Chúa Trời để giữ cho hòm khỏi ngã.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 나곤의 타작마당에 이르렀을 때, 웃사가 하나님의 궤로 [손을] 내밀어 그것을 붙잡았다. 소들이 비틀거렸기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그들이 나곤의 타작마당에 이르렀을 때, 웃사가 손을 내밀어 하나님의 궤를 붙잡았다. 소들이 비틀거렸기 때문이다.
ko.R: 그들이 나곤의 타작마당에 이르렀을 때 소들이 비틀거렸다. 그러자 웃사가 손을 뻗어 하나님의 궤를 붙잡아 흔들리지 않게 했다.

pt.L: E chegaram à eira de Nacom, e Uzá estendeu [a mão] para a arca de Deus e a segurou, porque os bois tropeçaram.
pt.B: Quando chegaram à eira de Nacom, Uzá estendeu a mão e segurou a arca de Deus, porque os bois tinham tropeçado.
pt.R: Quando chegaram à eira de Nacom, os bois tropeçaram. Uzá estendeu a mão e segurou a arca de Deus para que ela não caísse.

decisions.choice: the threshing floor of Nacon: a place on the road, not otherwise known
decisions.reason: A threshing floor was a flat open space of beaten earth or rock where grain was threshed. This one is named only here; 1 Chronicles 13:9 calls it the threshing floor of Chidon. "Nacon" may be a name, or a word meaning "firm" or "prepared".

decisions.choice: reached out: stretched out his hand
decisions.reason: The verb "send" is used without an object, as often when the hand is meant. 1 Chronicles 13:9 says "his hand".

decisions.choice: the oxen stumbled: the cart lurched
decisions.reason: The verb means "let drop" or "let loose". Here it probably means the oxen stumbled or slipped, so that the cart and the ark tipped. Some take it as "the oxen shook it" or "let it slip"; in each case the ark was in danger of falling.

decisions.choice: the oxen stumbled; reached out his hand ... to steady it
decisions.reason: Readable tells the events in the order they happened, putting the oxen's stumble first, adds "his hand" (as m2), and says why Uzzah took hold.

decisions.choice: estendeu [a mão]
decisions.reason: Portuguese "estender" needs an object, so Literal supplies "a mão" in brackets, as m2 explains; the English Literal says "reached out" without one. "Nacom" with the final "-m" Portuguese writes for a nasal ending.

source.text: וַיִּֽחַר־אַ֤ף יְהוָה֙ בְּעֻזָּ֔ה וַיַּכֵּ֥הוּ שָׁ֛ם הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים עַל־הַשַּׁ֑ל וַיָּ֣מָת שָׁ֔ם עִ֖ם אֲר֥וֹן הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And burned [the] anger of Yahweh against Uzzah, and struck him there the God for the error, and he died there beside [the] ark of the God.

en.L: And the anger of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} burned against Uzzah, and God struck him there for the error, and he died there beside the ark of God.
en.B: Then the anger of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} blazed against Uzzah, and God struck him down there for his error. He died there beside the ark of God.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} was very angry with Uzzah. God struck him down there because of his wrong act, and he died there beside the ark of God.

es.L: Y se encendió la ira {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} contra Uza, y Dios lo hirió allí por el error, y murió allí junto al arca de Dios.
es.B: Entonces la ira {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} ardió contra Uza, y Dios lo hirió allí por su falta. Murió allí junto al arca de Dios.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se enojó mucho con Uza. Dios lo hirió allí por lo que había hecho mal, y murió allí junto al arca de Dios.

fr.L: Et la colère {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} s’enflamma contre Ouzza, et Dieu le frappa là pour la faute, et il mourut là, près de l’arche de Dieu.
fr.B: Alors la colère {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} s’enflamma contre Ouzza, et Dieu le frappa là à cause de sa faute. Il mourut là, à côté de l’arche de Dieu.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} s’est mis en colère contre Ouzza. Dieu l’a frappé là à cause de son geste fautif, et Ouzza est mort sur place, à côté de l’arche de Dieu.

sw.L: Hasira ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ikawaka juu ya Uza, naye Mungu akampiga hapo kwa kosa hilo, naye akafa hapo kando ya sanduku la Mungu.
sw.B: Ndipo hasira ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ikawaka dhidi ya Uza, naye Mungu akampiga hapo kwa kosa lake. Akafa hapo kando ya sanduku la Mungu.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimkasirikia Uza sana. Mungu akampiga hapo kwa sababu ya kosa lake, naye akafa hapo kando ya sanduku la Mungu.

vi.L: Cơn giận của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nổi phừng lên cùng U-xa, và Đức Chúa Trời đánh ông tại đó vì sự lầm lỗi ấy, và ông chết tại đó bên cạnh hòm của Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: Bấy giờ cơn giận của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} bừng lên cùng U-xa, và Đức Chúa Trời đánh chết ông tại đó vì lỗi lầm ấy. Ông chết tại đó bên cạnh hòm của Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} rất giận U-xa. Đức Chúa Trời đánh ông tại đó vì việc làm sai trái của ông, và ông chết ngay bên cạnh hòm của Đức Chúa Trời.

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 진노가 웃사에게 타올랐고, 하나님께서 그 잘못 때문에 거기에서 그를 치셨다. 그래서 그가 거기 하나님의 궤 곁에서 죽었다.
ko.B: 그러자 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 웃사에게 크게 진노하셨고, 하나님께서 그의 잘못 때문에 거기에서 그를 치셨다. 그는 거기 하나님의 궤 곁에서 죽었다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 웃사에게 몹시 화가 나셨다. 하나님께서는 그가 잘못했기 때문에 거기에서 그를 치셨다. 웃사는 그 자리에서 하나님의 궤 곁에 쓰러져 죽었다.

pt.L: E a ira {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} se acendeu contra Uzá, e Deus o feriu ali por causa do erro, e ele morreu ali, junto da arca de Deus.
pt.B: Então a ira {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} se acendeu contra Uzá, e Deus o feriu ali por causa do seu erro. Ele morreu ali, ao lado da arca de Deus.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} ficou muito irado com Uzá. Deus o feriu ali por causa do que ele tinha feito de errado, e Uzá morreu ali, ao lado da arca de Deus.

decisions.choice: for the error: because of his rash fault
alternatives: because he reached out his hand to the ark (1 Chronicles 13:10)
decisions.reason: The noun is found only here. It is usually linked with a word meaning "error" or "negligence" (the same idea is used in Daniel 6:5 and Ezra 4:22), so it names a fault: Uzzah acted rashly with what was holy. Others take it as "irreverence". The Greek does not have the word, and 1 Chronicles 13:10 reads instead "because he put out his hand to the ark", which may be what the short word here means.

decisions.choice: the LORD's anger against Uzzah: the holiness of the ark
decisions.reason: The law warned that even the Levites who carried the holy things must not touch them, or they would die (Numbers 4:15), and many at Beth-shemesh had died for looking into the ark (1 Samuel 6:19). Uzzah meant to protect the ark, but it was holy, and it was being moved in a way the law did not allow (verse 3). The text tells what happened and does not explain further.

decisions.choice: God: the God, the true God
decisions.reason: The verse moves from "the LORD" to "the God", the form used for the ark throughout this story. Both name the same God.

decisions.choice: was very angry
decisions.reason: Readable says "was very angry" for the picture of anger that "burned".

source.text: וַיִּ֣חַר לְדָוִ֔ד עַל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר פָּרַ֧ץ יְהוָ֛ה פֶּ֖רֶץ בְּעֻזָּ֑ה וַיִּקְרָ֞א לַמָּק֤וֹם הַהוּא֙ פֶּ֣רֶץ עֻזָּ֔ה עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And it burned to David because broke out Yahweh [a] breaking out against Uzzah; and he called the place that Perez-uzzah until the day the this.

en.L: And David was angry because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had broken out [with] a breaking out against Uzzah; and he called that place Perez-uzzah, to this day.
en.B: David was angry because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had burst out against Uzzah, and he named that place Perez-uzzah, a name it still has to this day.
en.R: David was angry because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had burst out against Uzzah. So he named that place Perez-uzzah, which means "bursting out against Uzzah". It still has that name to this day.

es.L: Y se enojó David porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había irrumpido [con] una irrupción contra Uza; y llamó a aquel lugar Pérez-uza, hasta el día de hoy.
es.B: David se enojó porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había irrumpido contra Uza, y llamó a aquel lugar Pérez-uza, nombre que tiene hasta el día de hoy.
es.R: David se enojó porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había castigado de golpe a Uza. Por eso llamó a aquel lugar Pérez-uza, que significa «castigo repentino contra Uza». Todavía se llama así hasta el día de hoy.

fr.L: Et David fut irrité parce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait fait une brèche, une brèche contre Ouzza ; et il appela ce lieu Pérets-Ouzza, jusqu’à ce jour.
fr.B: David fut irrité parce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait éclaté contre Ouzza, et il nomma cet endroit Pérets-Ouzza, nom qu’il porte encore aujourd’hui.
fr.R: David s’est fâché parce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait éclaté contre Ouzza. Alors il a appelé cet endroit Pérets-Ouzza, ce qui veut dire « Éclat contre Ouzza ». Il porte encore ce nom aujourd’hui.

sw.L: Daudi akakasirika kwa sababu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amefurika [kwa] mfuriko juu ya Uza; akapaita mahali pale Peres-uza, mpaka siku hii ya leo.
sw.B: Daudi alikasirika kwa sababu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa amemfurikia Uza kwa hasira, akapaita mahali pale Peres-uza, jina ambalo pana mpaka leo.
sw.R: Daudi alikasirika kwa sababu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa amemshukia Uza ghafula. Basi akapaita mahali pale Peres-uza, maana yake "kumshukia Uza." Pangali panaitwa hivyo mpaka leo.

vi.L: Đa-vít nổi giận vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã giáng [một] sự phá vỡ trên U-xa; và ông gọi nơi ấy là Phê-rết U-xa cho đến ngày nay.
vi.B: Đa-vít nổi giận vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã bùng nổ cơn giận trên U-xa, và ông gọi nơi ấy là Phê-rết U-xa, tên ấy vẫn còn cho đến ngày nay.
vi.R: Đa-vít nổi giận vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã bùng nổ cơn giận trên U-xa. Vì vậy ông đặt tên nơi ấy là Phê-rết U-xa, nghĩa là "Sự bùng nổ trên U-xa". Nơi ấy vẫn mang tên đó cho đến ngày nay.

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 웃사를 쳐서 터뜨리셨기 때문에 다윗이 화가 났다. 그리고 그가 그곳을 베레스웃사라고 불렀는데, 오늘날까지 [그렇게 불린다].
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 웃사를 갑자기 치셨기 때문에 다윗은 화가 났다. 그래서 그는 그곳을 베레스웃사라고 불렀는데, 그곳은 오늘날까지 그렇게 불린다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 갑자기 웃사를 치셨기 때문에 다윗은 화가 났다. 그래서 그는 그곳을 '웃사를 치심'이라는 뜻으로 베레스웃사라고 불렀다. 그곳은 오늘날까지 그 이름으로 불린다.

pt.L: E Davi se irou porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha rompido [com] um rompimento contra Uzá; e chamou aquele lugar Perez-Uzá, até o dia de hoje.
pt.B: Davi ficou irado porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha rompido contra Uzá, e deu àquele lugar o nome de Perez-Uzá, nome que ele tem até hoje.
pt.R: Davi ficou irado porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha rompido com fúria contra Uzá. Por isso deu àquele lugar o nome de Perez-Uzá, que quer dizer "rompimento contra Uzá". O lugar tem esse nome até hoje.

decisions.choice: David was angry
decisions.reason: The verb is the same "burn" used of the LORD's anger in verse 7, here without the word "anger". It may also mean that David was deeply upset or distressed, as with Jonah (Jonah 4:1, 4). The text does not say whether his anger was against the LORD, against himself, or at what had happened.

decisions.choice: broken out ... Perez-uzzah: the LORD's outburst against Uzzah
decisions.reason: The verb "break out, burst through" and the noun from it give the place its name, Perez-uzzah, "breaking out against Uzzah". In the chapter before, David named Baal-perazim because the LORD had "broken out" against his enemies like a flood (5:20). Now the LORD breaks out against one of his own people. The same word is used of the LORD's warning at Sinai not to come too near, "or he will break out against them" (Exodus 19:22, 24).

decisions.choice: to this day: the writer's own day
decisions.reason: As in 4:3: the name was still in use when the account was written.

decisions.choice: which means "bursting out against Uzzah"
decisions.reason: Readable explains the meaning of the name, which the Hebrew reader would hear at once.

decisions.choice: "cho đến ngày nay" at every level
decisions.reason: "To this day" is the writer's own day, as the Samuel and Chronicles terms note sets; Vietnamese "ngày nay" reads as a lasting time, not this very day.

decisions.choice: rompido, rompimento; Perez-Uzá
decisions.reason: The verb and the noun keep the "romper", "rompimento" of Baal-Perazim (5:20), so that the reader hears what m2 points to: the LORD who broke through David's enemies now breaks out against Uzzah. "Perez-Uzá" joins the two names with a hyphen, both capitalised, as "Baal-Perazim"; Readable gives the meaning, as the English does.

source.text: וַיִּרָ֥א דָוִ֛ד אֶת־יְהוָ֖ה בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא וַיֹּ֕אמֶר אֵ֛יךְ יָב֥וֹא אֵלַ֖י אֲר֥וֹן יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And feared David Yahweh on the day the that, and he said, How will come to me [the] ark of Yahweh?

en.L: And David feared {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} on that day, and he said, "How shall the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} come to me?"
en.B: David was afraid of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} that day, and he said, "How can the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} ever come to me?"
en.R: That day David was afraid of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. He said, "How can the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} ever come to stay with me?"

es.L: Y temió David {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} aquel día, y dijo: «¿Cómo ha de venir a mí el arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}?».
es.B: Aquel día David tuvo miedo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y dijo: «¿Cómo podrá venir a mí el arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}?».
es.R: Aquel día David tuvo miedo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Dijo: «¿Cómo podrá el arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} venir a quedarse conmigo?».

fr.L: Et David eut peur {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ce jour-là, et il dit : « Comment l’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} viendra-t-elle chez moi ? »
fr.B: Ce jour-là, David eut peur {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et il dit : « Comment l’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} pourrait-elle jamais venir chez moi ? »
fr.R: Ce jour-là, David a eu peur {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Il a dit : « Comment l’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} pourrait-elle venir rester chez moi ? »

sw.L: Daudi akamwogopa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} siku ile, akasema, "Sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} litakujaje kwangu?"
sw.B: Siku ile Daudi alimwogopa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akasema, "Sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} litawezaje kuja kwangu?"
sw.R: Siku ile Daudi alimwogopa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Akasema, "Sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} litawezaje kuja kukaa kwangu?"

vi.L: Ngày ấy Đa-vít sợ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và nói: "Làm sao hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đến với tôi được?"
vi.B: Ngày ấy Đa-vít sợ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và nói: "Làm sao hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} có thể đến với tôi được?"
vi.R: Ngày ấy Đa-vít sợ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Ông nói: "Làm sao hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} có thể đến ở với tôi được?"

ko.L: 그리고 그날 다윗이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 두려워하여 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤가 어떻게 나에게 오겠느냐?"
ko.B: 그날 다윗은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 두려워하며 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤를 어떻게 내가 모셔 올 수 있겠느냐?"
ko.R: 그날 다윗은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 두려웠다. 다윗이 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤가 어떻게 내 곁에 머물 수 있겠느냐?"

pt.L: E Davi temeu {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} naquele dia, e disse: "Como virá a mim a arca {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}?"
pt.B: Naquele dia Davi teve medo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e disse: "Como é que a arca {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} poderá vir para junto de mim?"
pt.R: Naquele dia Davi teve medo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. Ele disse: "Como é que a arca {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} poderá vir ficar comigo?"

decisions.choice: feared the LORD: was afraid of him
decisions.reason: The verb can mean reverence or awe, but here, after Uzzah's death, it is plain fear of what the LORD might do.

decisions.choice: How can the ark come to me?: a question of fear and doubt
decisions.reason: The question does not ask for a method. It means that David no longer dares to bring the ark into his own city (verse 10). "To me" means to the place where David lives and rules.

decisions.choice: come to stay with me
decisions.reason: Readable adds "to stay", since David was bringing the ark to his city to remain there.

decisions.choice: David says "tôi" when he speaks to himself and his people about the ark
decisions.reason: Not addressing a subject but voicing his own fear, he does not use the king's "ta".

source.text: וְלֹֽא־אָבָ֣ה דָוִ֗ד לְהָסִ֥יר אֵלָ֛יו אֶת־אֲר֥וֹן יְהוָ֖ה עַל־עִ֣יר דָּוִ֑ד וַיַּטֵּ֣הוּ דָוִ֔ד בֵּ֥ית עֹבֵֽד־אֱד֖וֹם הַגִּתִּֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And not was willing David to turn aside to him [the] ark of Yahweh to [the] city of David; and turned it aside David [to the] house of Obed-Edom the Gittite.

en.L: And David was not willing to move the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} to himself, into the city of David; and David turned it aside [to the] house of Obed-Edom the Gittite.
en.B: So David was not willing to take the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} into the city of David to be with him. Instead he turned aside and took it to the house of Obed-Edom the Gittite.
en.R: So David decided not to take the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} home with him to the city of David. Instead, he had it taken off the road to the house of a man named Obed-Edom, who came from Gath.

es.L: Y no quiso David trasladar a sí el arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} a la ciudad de David; y David la desvió [a la] casa de Obed-edom el geteo.
es.B: Así que David no quiso llevar el arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} a la ciudad de David para tenerla consigo. En lugar de eso, se desvió y la llevó a la casa de Obed-edom el geteo.
es.R: Así que David decidió no llevarse el arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} a la ciudad de David. En cambio, hizo que la sacaran del camino y la llevaran a la casa de un hombre llamado Obed-edom, que era de Gat.

fr.L: Et David ne voulut pas détourner vers lui l’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, dans la cité de David ; et David la fit détourner [vers la] maison d’Obed-Édom le Guittite.
fr.B: David ne voulut donc pas emmener l’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} chez lui, dans la cité de David. Il la fit plutôt détourner vers la maison d’Obed-Édom le Guittite.
fr.R: Alors David a décidé de ne pas emmener l’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} chez lui, dans la cité de David. À la place, il l’a fait conduire hors de la route, chez un homme appelé Obed-Édom, qui venait de Gath.

sw.L: Daudi hakutaka kulihamishia sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwake, katika mji wa Daudi; Daudi akaligeuza [kwenda] nyumba ya Obed-edomu Mgiti.
sw.B: Basi Daudi hakutaka kulileta sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} katika mji wa Daudi likae pamoja naye. Badala yake aligeuka akalipeleka nyumbani kwa Obed-edomu Mgiti.
sw.R: Basi Daudi aliamua kutolipeleka sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} nyumbani kwake katika mji wa Daudi. Badala yake, aliagiza litolewe njiani lipelekwe nyumbani kwa mtu aitwaye Obed-edomu, aliyetoka Gathi.

vi.L: Đa-vít không muốn đem hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} về với mình, vào thành Đa-vít; Đa-vít cho rẽ hòm sang [nhà] Ô-bết Ê-đôm người Gát.
vi.B: Vậy Đa-vít không muốn đem hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} vào thành Đa-vít để ở với mình. Thay vào đó, ông cho đưa hòm rẽ sang nhà Ô-bết Ê-đôm người Gát.
vi.R: Vì vậy Đa-vít quyết định không đem hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} về thành Đa-vít với mình. Thay vào đó, ông cho người đưa hòm rẽ khỏi đường đến nhà một người tên là Ô-bết Ê-đôm, quê ở Gát.

ko.L: 그리고 다윗은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤를 다윗 성으로, 자기에게로 옮기려고 하지 않았다. 그리고 다윗이 그것을 가드 사람 오벳에돔의 집으로 돌렸다.
ko.B: 그래서 다윗은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤를 다윗 성 안 자기 곁으로 옮기려 하지 않고, 방향을 돌려 가드 사람 오벳에돔의 집으로 가져갔다.
ko.R: 그래서 다윗은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤를 다윗 성 자기 집으로 가져가지 않기로 했다. 그 대신 그는 궤를 길에서 돌려 오벳에돔이라는 사람의 집으로 옮기게 했다. 오벳에돔은 가드 출신이었다.

pt.L: E Davi não quis levar a arca {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} para junto de si, para a Cidade de Davi; e Davi a desviou [para a] casa de Obede-Edom, o geteu.
pt.B: Por isso Davi não quis levar a arca {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} para a Cidade de Davi, para junto de si. Em vez disso, desviou-se do caminho e a levou para a casa de Obede-Edom, o geteu.
pt.R: Por isso Davi resolveu não levar a arca {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} para casa, para a Cidade de Davi. Em vez disso, mandou levá-la para fora do caminho, para a casa de um homem chamado Obede-Edom, que era de Gate.

decisions.choice: the city of David: the stronghold of Zion
decisions.reason: David had captured the Jebusite stronghold of Zion and named it the city of David (5:7, 9). It was the oldest part of Jerusalem.

decisions.choice: Obed-Edom the Gittite: a man from a town called Gath
decisions.reason: "Gittite" means a man from Gath. This could be the Philistine city, since David had men from there among his followers (15:18-19). It could also be Gath-rimmon, a town given to the Levites (Joshua 21:24-25), and 1 Chronicles 15:18, 24 and 16:38 name an Obed-Edom among the Levite gatekeepers and musicians who served the ark. The text here does not say which.

decisions.choice: had it taken off the road; who came from Gath
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what "turned it aside" means and what "Gittite" means.

decisions.choice: "Obed-edom el geteo" (L, B); "que era de Gat" (R)
decisions.reason: "Geteo" is the usual Spanish word for a man of Gath; Readable explains it, as the English does.

decisions.choice: Obede-Edom, o geteu; que era de Gate (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book (also 15:18-22; 18:2): "Obede-Edom", with the "Obede" of Ruth 4:17, and "geteu", the Portuguese word for a man of Gate (m2); Readable says it plainly, as the English does. "Cidade de Davi" keeps its capital, as in 5:7.

source.text: וַיֵּשֶׁב֩ אֲר֨וֹן יְהוָ֜ה בֵּ֣ית עֹבֵ֥ד אֱדֹ֛ם הַגִּתִּ֖י שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה חֳדָשִׁ֑ים וַיְבָ֧רֶךְ יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־עֹבֵ֥ד אֱדֹ֖ם וְאֶת־כָּל־בֵּיתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And remained [the] ark of Yahweh [at the] house of Obed-Edom the Gittite three months; and blessed Yahweh Obed-Edom and all his household.

en.L: And the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} remained [at the] house of Obed-Edom the Gittite three months, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} blessed Obed-Edom and all his household.
en.B: The ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} stayed three months at the house of Obed-Edom the Gittite, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} blessed Obed-Edom and his whole household.
en.R: The ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} stayed at Obed-Edom's house for three months. And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} blessed Obed-Edom and his whole household.

es.L: Y permaneció el arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} [en la] casa de Obed-edom el geteo tres meses, y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} bendijo a Obed-edom y a toda su casa.
es.B: El arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} se quedó tres meses en la casa de Obed-edom el geteo, y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} bendijo a Obed-edom y a toda su familia.
es.R: El arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} se quedó en la casa de Obed-edom durante tres meses. Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} bendijo a Obed-edom y a toda su familia.

fr.L: Et l’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} demeura [dans la] maison d’Obed-Édom le Guittite trois mois, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} bénit Obed-Édom et toute sa maison.
fr.B: L’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} resta trois mois dans la maison d’Obed-Édom le Guittite, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} bénit Obed-Édom et toute sa maison.
fr.R: L’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} est restée trois mois chez Obed-Édom. Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a béni Obed-Édom et toute sa famille.

sw.L: Sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} likakaa [katika] nyumba ya Obed-edomu Mgiti miezi mitatu, naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akambariki Obed-edomu na nyumba yake yote.
sw.B: Sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} lilikaa nyumbani kwa Obed-edomu Mgiti kwa miezi mitatu, naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akambariki Obed-edomu na watu wote wa nyumbani mwake.
sw.R: Sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} lilikaa nyumbani kwa Obed-edomu kwa miezi mitatu. Naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akambariki Obed-edomu na jamaa yake yote.

vi.L: Hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở [tại] nhà Ô-bết Ê-đôm người Gát ba tháng, và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban phước cho Ô-bết Ê-đôm và cả nhà ông.
vi.B: Hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở lại nhà Ô-bết Ê-đôm người Gát ba tháng, và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban phước cho Ô-bết Ê-đôm cùng cả nhà ông.
vi.R: Hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở tại nhà Ô-bết Ê-đôm ba tháng. Và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban phước cho Ô-bết Ê-đôm cùng cả gia đình ông.

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤가 가드 사람 오벳에돔의 집에 석 달 동안 머물렀다. 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 오벳에돔과 그의 온 집안에 복을 주셨다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤는 가드 사람 오벳에돔의 집에서 석 달 동안 머물렀고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 오벳에돔과 그의 온 집안에 복을 주셨다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤는 오벳에돔의 집에 석 달 동안 있었다. 그동안 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 오벳에돔과 그의 온 집안에 복을 주셨다.

pt.L: E a arca {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} ficou [na] casa de Obede-Edom, o geteu, três meses, e {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} abençoou Obede-Edom e toda a sua casa.
pt.B: A arca {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} ficou três meses na casa de Obede-Edom, o geteu, e {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} abençoou Obede-Edom e toda a sua família.
pt.R: A arca {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} ficou na casa de Obede-Edom durante três meses. E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} abençoou Obede-Edom e toda a família dele.

decisions.choice: the LORD blessed Obed-Edom: the ark brings blessing as well as judgment
decisions.reason: The same ark that had brought death to Uzzah brought good to the household that kept it. The ark had also brought disaster on the Philistines who held it (1 Samuel 5). 1 Chronicles 26:4-5 speaks of the many sons God gave Obed-Edom.

decisions.choice: household: his family and everyone who lived under his care
decisions.reason: The word "house" here means the household: family, servants and goods (compare verse 12, "all that is his").

source.text: וַיֻּגַּ֗ד לַמֶּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִד֮ לֵאמֹר֒ בֵּרַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֗ה אֶת־בֵּ֨ית עֹבֵ֤ד אֱדֹם֙ וְאֶת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר־ל֔וֹ בַּעֲב֖וּר אֲר֣וֹן הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ דָּוִ֗ד וַיַּעַל֩ אֶת־אֲר֨וֹן הָאֱלֹהִ֜ים מִבֵּ֨ית עֹבֵ֥ד אֱדֹ֛ם עִ֥יר דָּוִ֖ד בְּשִׂמְחָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was told to the king David, saying, Has blessed Yahweh [the] house of Obed-Edom and all that [is] to him because of [the] ark of the God. And went David and brought up [the] ark of the God from [the] house of Obed-Edom [to the] city of David with joy.

en.L: And it was told to King David, saying, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has blessed the house of Obed-Edom and all that [is] his, because of the ark of God." And David went and brought up the ark of God from the house of Obed-Edom [to the] city of David with rejoicing.
en.B: King David was told, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has blessed the household of Obed-Edom and everything he has because of the ark of God." So David went and brought the ark of God up from the house of Obed-Edom to the city of David with rejoicing.
en.R: Someone told King David, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has blessed Obed-Edom's family and everything he owns, because the ark of God is there." So David went with great joy and brought the ark of God up from Obed-Edom's house to the city of David.

es.L: Y se le informó al rey David, diciendo: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha bendecido la casa de Obed-edom y todo lo que [es] suyo, a causa del arca de Dios». Y fue David e hizo subir el arca de Dios de la casa de Obed-edom [a la] ciudad de David con alegría.
es.B: Al rey David le dijeron: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha bendecido a la familia de Obed-edom y todo lo que tiene a causa del arca de Dios». Entonces David fue e hizo subir el arca de Dios desde la casa de Obed-edom a la ciudad de David con alegría.
es.R: Alguien le dijo al rey David: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha bendecido a la familia de Obed-edom y todo lo que tiene, porque el arca de Dios está allí». Entonces David fue con gran alegría e hizo subir el arca de Dios desde la casa de Obed-edom a la ciudad de David.

fr.L: Et on informa le roi David, en disant : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a béni la maison d’Obed-Édom et tout ce qui [est] à lui, à cause de l’arche de Dieu. » Et David alla et fit monter l’arche de Dieu de la maison d’Obed-Édom [à la] cité de David avec joie.
fr.B: On vint dire au roi David : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a béni la maison d’Obed-Édom et tout ce qu’il possède, à cause de l’arche de Dieu. » Alors David alla faire monter l’arche de Dieu de la maison d’Obed-Édom à la cité de David, dans la joie.
fr.R: Quelqu’un a dit au roi David : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a béni la famille d’Obed-Édom et tout ce qu’il possède, parce que l’arche de Dieu est chez lui. » Alors David est allé, plein de joie, chercher l’arche de Dieu chez Obed-Édom pour la faire monter à la cité de David.

sw.L: Mfalme Daudi akaambiwa hivi, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ameibariki nyumba ya Obed-edomu na vyote alivyo navyo, kwa sababu ya sanduku la Mungu." Daudi akaenda akalipandisha sanduku la Mungu kutoka nyumba ya Obed-edomu [mpaka] mji wa Daudi kwa furaha.
sw.B: Mfalme Daudi aliambiwa, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ameibariki jamaa ya Obed-edomu na kila kitu alicho nacho kwa sababu ya sanduku la Mungu." Basi Daudi akaenda akalipandisha sanduku la Mungu kutoka nyumbani kwa Obed-edomu mpaka mji wa Daudi kwa shangwe.
sw.R: Mtu mmoja akamwambia mfalme Daudi, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ameibariki jamaa ya Obed-edomu na kila kitu alicho nacho, kwa sababu sanduku la Mungu liko huko." Basi Daudi akaenda kwa furaha kubwa, akalipandisha sanduku la Mungu kutoka nyumbani kwa Obed-edomu mpaka mji wa Daudi.

vi.L: Người ta báo cho vua Đa-vít rằng: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã ban phước cho nhà Ô-bết Ê-đôm và mọi thứ ông có, vì cớ hòm của Đức Chúa Trời." Đa-vít đi rước hòm của Đức Chúa Trời từ nhà Ô-bết Ê-đôm lên thành Đa-vít với sự vui mừng.
vi.B: Có người tâu với vua Đa-vít: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã ban phước cho nhà Ô-bết Ê-đôm và mọi thứ ông có vì cớ hòm của Đức Chúa Trời." Vậy Đa-vít đi rước hòm của Đức Chúa Trời từ nhà Ô-bết Ê-đôm lên thành Đa-vít trong niềm hân hoan.
vi.R: Có người báo cho vua Đa-vít: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã ban phước cho gia đình Ô-bết Ê-đôm và mọi thứ ông có, vì hòm của Đức Chúa Trời ở đó." Vậy Đa-vít vui mừng đi rước hòm của Đức Chúa Trời từ nhà Ô-bết Ê-đôm lên thành Đa-vít.

ko.L: 그리고 사람들이 다윗 왕에게 알려 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하나님의 궤 때문에 오벳에돔의 집과 그에게 [속한] 모든 것에 복을 주셨습니다." 그리고 다윗이 가서 기쁨으로 하나님의 궤를 오벳에돔의 집에서 다윗 성으로 메어 올렸다.
ko.B: 누군가 다윗 왕에게 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하나님의 궤 때문에 오벳에돔의 집안과 그의 모든 소유에 복을 주셨습니다." 그래서 다윗은 가서 기쁨 가운데 하나님의 궤를 오벳에돔의 집에서 다윗 성으로 메어 올렸다.
ko.R: 누군가 다윗 왕에게 말했다. "하나님의 궤가 오벳에돔의 집에 있어서, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그의 가족과 그가 가진 모든 것에 복을 주셨습니다." 그래서 다윗은 가서 크게 기뻐하며 하나님의 궤를 오벳에돔의 집에서 다윗 성으로 메어 올렸다.

pt.L: E foi anunciado ao rei Davi, dizendo: "{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} abençoou a casa de Obede-Edom e tudo o que [é] dele, por causa da arca de Deus." E Davi foi e fez subir a arca de Deus da casa de Obede-Edom [para a] Cidade de Davi com alegria.
pt.B: Contaram ao rei Davi: "{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} abençoou a família de Obede-Edom e tudo o que ele tem por causa da arca de Deus." Então Davi foi e levou a arca de Deus da casa de Obede-Edom para a Cidade de Davi, com festa e alegria.
pt.R: Alguém contou ao rei Davi: "{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} abençoou a família de Obede-Edom e tudo o que ele tem, porque a arca de Deus está lá." Então Davi foi com muita alegria e levou a arca de Deus da casa de Obede-Edom para a Cidade de Davi.

decisions.choice: blessed because of the ark: the LORD's presence brings good where he is honored
decisions.reason: The report answers David's fear (verse 9). The ark had not only brought death; where it was kept with care, the LORD blessed. This gives David the courage to try again.

decisions.choice: with rejoicing: with celebration
decisions.reason: The word means joy shown openly, with feasting, music and dancing, as the next verses describe (verses 13-15).

decisions.choice: brought up: carried up to the higher city
decisions.reason: Jerusalem stood high in the hill country, so going there is "going up"; the same verb is used for bringing the ark from Baale-judah (verse 2).

decisions.choice: Someone told; because the ark of God is there
decisions.reason: Readable gives the passive "it was told" a subject and says what "because of the ark" means.

source.text: וַיְהִ֗י כִּ֧י צָעֲד֛וּ נֹשְׂאֵ֥י אֲרוֹן־יְהוָ֖ה שִׁשָּׁ֣ה צְעָדִ֑ים וַיִּזְבַּ֥ח שׁ֖וֹר וּמְרִֽיא׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was, when had stepped [the] carriers of [the] ark of Yahweh six steps, and he sacrificed an ox and a fatling.

en.L: And it happened, when those carrying the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had gone six steps, [that] he sacrificed an ox and a fatling.
en.B: When those carrying the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had gone six steps, David sacrificed an ox and a fattened calf.
en.R: This time men carried the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. When they had gone six steps, David offered an ox and a fattened calf as a sacrifice.

es.L: Y sucedió que, cuando los que llevaban el arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} habían dado seis pasos, él sacrificó un buey y un animal cebado.
es.B: Cuando los que llevaban el arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} habían dado seis pasos, David sacrificó un buey y un ternero cebado.
es.R: Esta vez unos hombres llevaban el arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Cuando habían dado seis pasos, David ofreció en sacrificio un buey y un ternero cebado.

fr.L: Et il arriva, quand ceux qui portaient l’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} eurent fait six pas, [qu’]il sacrifia un bœuf et un veau gras.
fr.B: Quand ceux qui portaient l’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} eurent fait six pas, David sacrifia un bœuf et un veau gras.
fr.R: Cette fois, des hommes portaient l’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Quand ils ont eu fait six pas, David a offert en sacrifice un bœuf et un veau gras.

sw.L: Ikawa, wale waliolibeba sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} walipokuwa wamepiga hatua sita, akatoa dhabihu ng'ombe na ndama aliyenona.
sw.B: Wale waliolibeba sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} walipokuwa wamepiga hatua sita, Daudi alitoa dhabihu ya ng'ombe na ndama aliyenona.
sw.R: Safari hii watu walilibeba sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Walipokuwa wamepiga hatua sita, Daudi alitoa ng'ombe na ndama aliyenona kuwa dhabihu.

vi.L: Khi những người khiêng hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã đi được sáu bước, thì ông dâng một con bò đực và một con thú béo.
vi.B: Khi những người khiêng hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã đi được sáu bước, Đa-vít dâng một con bò đực và một con bê béo làm sinh tế.
vi.R: Lần này người ta khiêng hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Khi họ vừa đi được sáu bước, Đa-vít dâng một con bò đực và một con bê béo làm sinh tế.

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤를 멘 사람들이 여섯 걸음을 걸었을 때, 그가 소 한 마리와 살진 짐승 한 마리를 제물로 바쳤다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤를 멘 사람들이 여섯 걸음을 옮겼을 때, 다윗은 소 한 마리와 살진 송아지 한 마리를 제물로 바쳤다.
ko.R: 이번에는 사람들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤를 어깨에 메었다. 그들이 여섯 걸음을 옮기자, 다윗은 소 한 마리와 살진 송아지 한 마리를 제물로 바쳤다.

pt.L: E aconteceu que, quando os que carregavam a arca {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} deram seis passos, ele sacrificou um boi e um novilho gordo.
pt.B: Quando os que carregavam a arca {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} tinham dado seis passos, Davi sacrificou um boi e um bezerro cevado.
pt.R: Desta vez a arca {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} foi carregada por homens. Quando eles tinham dado seis passos, Davi ofereceu em sacrifício um boi e um bezerro gordo.

decisions.choice: those carrying the ark: carried this time, not set on a cart
decisions.reason: On the first attempt the ark rode on a cart (verse 3). Now it is carried, as the law required (Numbers 4:15; 7:9); 1 Chronicles 15:2, 13-15 says the Levites carried it on poles on their shoulders.

decisions.choice: after six steps, he sacrificed: once, at the start of the journey
decisions.reason: The sentence most naturally means that after the first six steps, when the carriers had come to no harm, David stopped and offered a sacrifice. Some have read it as a sacrifice every six steps, but the Hebrew does not say "every". 1 Chronicles 15:26 adds that seven bulls and seven rams were sacrificed because God helped the Levites who carried the ark.

decisions.choice: an ox and a fatling: a bull and a fattened animal
decisions.reason: The second word means an animal fattened for sacrifice or a feast, usually a young bull or calf (Isaiah 11:6).

decisions.choice: David sacrificed; This time men carried
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name David as the one who sacrificed. Readable adds "This time" to show the change from the cart in verse 3.

source.text: וְדָוִ֛ד מְכַרְכֵּ֥ר בְּכָל־עֹ֖ז לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְדָוִ֕ד חָג֖וּר אֵפ֥וֹד בָּֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And David [was] whirling with all strength before Yahweh; and David [was] girded [with an] ephod of linen.

en.L: And David [was] whirling with all [his] strength before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and David [was] girded [with] a linen ephod.
en.B: David was dancing before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} with all his might, and he was wearing a linen ephod.
en.R: David danced with all his strength in front of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. He was wearing a linen ephod, a simple garment like the ones priests wore.

es.L: Y David [danzaba] girando con toda [su] fuerza delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y David [estaba] ceñido [con] un efod de lino.
es.B: David danzaba delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} con todas sus fuerzas, y llevaba puesto un efod de lino.
es.R: David bailaba con todas sus fuerzas delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Llevaba puesto un efod de lino, una prenda sencilla como las que usaban los sacerdotes.

fr.L: Et David tournoyait de toute [sa] force devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et David [était] ceint d’un éphod de lin.
fr.B: David dansait de toutes ses forces devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et il portait un éphod de lin.
fr.R: David dansait de toutes ses forces devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Il portait un éphod de lin, un vêtement simple comme ceux que portaient les prêtres.

sw.L: Daudi [alikuwa] akizunguka-zunguka kwa nguvu zote mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, naye Daudi [alikuwa] amejifunga efodi ya kitani.
sw.B: Daudi alikuwa akicheza mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa nguvu zake zote, naye alikuwa amevaa efodi ya kitani.
sw.R: Daudi alicheza kwa nguvu zake zote mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Alikuwa amevaa efodi ya kitani, vazi rahisi kama lile walilovaa makuhani.

vi.L: Đa-vít nhảy múa quay cuồng hết sức mình trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; Đa-vít thắt áo ê-phót bằng vải gai.
vi.B: Đa-vít hết sức nhảy múa trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và ông mặc áo ê-phót bằng vải gai.
vi.R: Đa-vít dùng hết sức nhảy múa trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Ông mặc áo ê-phót bằng vải gai, là loại áo đơn sơ giống áo các thầy tế lễ mặc.

ko.L: 그리고 다윗이 온 힘을 다하여 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 빙빙 돌며 춤추고 [있었다]. 그리고 다윗은 베 에봇을 두르고 [있었다].
ko.B: 다윗은 온 힘을 다해 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 춤을 추었다. 그는 베 에봇을 입고 있었다.
ko.R: 다윗은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 온 힘을 다해 춤을 추었다. 그는 베 에봇을 입고 있었다. 에봇은 제사장들이 입던 것과 같은 간단한 옷이었다.

pt.L: E Davi rodopiava com toda [a sua] força diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, e Davi [estava] cingido [com] um éfode de linho.
pt.B: Davi dançava com todas as forças diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, vestido com um éfode de linho.
pt.R: Davi dançava com todas as forças diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. Ele estava vestido com um éfode de linho, uma roupa simples que os sacerdotes usavam.

decisions.choice: whirling: dancing, spinning round
decisions.reason: The verb is found only here and in verse 16. It seems to describe a turning, whirling dance done with full energy.

decisions.choice: a linen ephod: the plain garment of those who served at the sanctuary
decisions.reason: The boy Samuel wore a linen ephod while serving the LORD at Shiloh (1 Samuel 2:18), and the priests of Nob were "men who wore the linen ephod" (1 Samuel 22:18). It was a short garment tied around the body, not the high priest's ephod of gold and colored yarn (Exodus 28:6-14). David leads the worship in clothes of service rather than in royal robes, and the short garment explains Michal's words in verse 20.

decisions.choice: dancing
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "dancing"; Literal keeps the picture of "whirling".

decisions.choice: a simple garment like the ones priests wore
decisions.reason: Readable explains the ephod, a word most readers will not know.

decisions.choice: un éphod de lin
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note sets: the name of the garment is kept, and Readable explains it, as the English does.

decisions.choice: efodi ya kitani; R adds "vazi rahisi kama lile walilovaa makuhani"
decisions.reason: "Ephod" is "efodi", "a linen ephod" "efodi ya kitani", as set for Samuel in Swahili; Readable explains it as the English does.

decisions.choice: "áo ê-phót bằng vải gai"
decisions.reason: The Samuel terms note's form; Readable says what the garment was, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "베 에봇" for the linen ephod, explained at Readable
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note: the name is kept, and Readable explains it as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: rodopiava (L), dançava (B, R) com todas as forças; um éfode de linho
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the whirling picture (m1) with "rodopiar"; Balanced and Readable say "dançava", as the English does, and "com todas as forças", the plain Portuguese for "with all his might". "Um éfode de linho" is the garment Samuel wore in 1 Samuel 2:18, and Readable explains it in the words used there in Portuguese.

source.text: וְדָוִד֙ וְכָל־בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מַעֲלִ֖ים אֶת־אֲר֣וֹן יְהוָ֑ה בִּתְרוּעָ֖ה וּבְק֥וֹל שׁוֹפָֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And David and all [the] house of Israel [were] bringing up [the] ark of Yahweh with shouting and with [the] sound of [the] ram's horn.

en.L: And David and all the house of Israel [were] bringing up the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} with shouting and with the sound of the ram's horn.
en.B: So David and the whole house of Israel brought up the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} with loud shouts of joy and the sound of the ram's horn.
en.R: So David and all the people of Israel brought the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} up to the city. They shouted with joy, and the ram's horn was blown.

es.L: Y David y toda la casa de Israel [hacían] subir el arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} con gritos y con el sonido del cuerno de carnero.
es.B: Así David y toda la casa de Israel subieron el arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} con gritos de alegría y al son del cuerno de carnero.
es.R: Así David y todo el pueblo de Israel subieron el arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} a la ciudad. Gritaban de alegría, y se tocaba el cuerno de carnero.

fr.L: Et David et toute la maison d’Israël faisaient monter l’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} avec des acclamations et au son du cor.
fr.B: Ainsi David et toute la maison d’Israël firent monter l’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} au milieu des cris de joie et au son du cor.
fr.R: C’est ainsi que David et tout le peuple d’Israël ont fait monter l’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} jusqu’à la ville. Ils poussaient des cris de joie, et on sonnait de la corne de bélier.

sw.L: Daudi na nyumba yote ya Israeli [walikuwa] wakilipandisha sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa kelele za shangwe na kwa sauti ya baragumu.
sw.B: Basi Daudi na nyumba yote ya Israeli walilipandisha sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa kelele kuu za shangwe na kwa sauti ya baragumu.
sw.R: Basi Daudi na watu wote wa Israeli walilipandisha sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} mpaka mjini. Walipiga kelele za furaha, na baragumu likapigwa.

vi.L: Đa-vít và cả nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên rước hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} lên với tiếng reo hò và tiếng tù và.
vi.B: Vậy Đa-vít và cả nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên rước hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} lên giữa tiếng reo hò vui mừng và tiếng tù và.
vi.R: Vậy Đa-vít và toàn dân Y-sơ-ra-ên rước hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} lên thành. Họ reo hò vui mừng, và tiếng tù và vang lên.

ko.L: 그리고 다윗과 이스라엘 온 집이 함성과 숫양 뿔 나팔 소리 가운데 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤를 메어 올리고 [있었다].
ko.B: 이렇게 다윗과 이스라엘 온 집안은 기쁨의 함성을 지르고 숫양 뿔 나팔을 불며 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤를 메어 올렸다.
ko.R: 이렇게 다윗과 이스라엘의 모든 백성은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤를 성으로 메어 올렸다. 사람들은 기뻐 소리쳤고, 숫양 뿔 나팔 소리가 울려 퍼졌다.

pt.L: E Davi e toda a casa de Israel faziam subir a arca {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} com gritos e com o som da trombeta.
pt.B: Assim Davi e toda a casa de Israel levaram para cima a arca {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} com gritos de alegria e com o som do chifre de carneiro.
pt.R: Assim Davi e todo o povo de Israel levaram a arca {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} para a cidade. Eles gritavam de alegria, e tocavam a trombeta.

decisions.choice: shouting: a loud shout of acclaim
decisions.reason: The word is used for a battle cry and for the joyful shout that greets a king or the LORD. When the ark came into Israel's camp before the battle with the Philistines, Israel raised the same great shout (1 Samuel 4:5); here it is the shout of a procession welcoming the LORD as king.

decisions.choice: the ram's horn: the shofar
decisions.reason: The ram's horn was blown for signals in war and for festivals and holy days (Leviticus 25:9; Joshua 6:4-5).

decisions.choice: shouts of joy
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable add "of joy", since the setting makes clear it is a shout of celebration, not of battle.

decisions.choice: all the people of Israel
decisions.reason: As in verse 5.

decisions.choice: "tù và" at every level
decisions.reason: Here the Hebrew names the shofar, the ram's horn (meaning decision), and the English says so at every level; at 2:28 Literal and Balanced said "kèn" because the English said "trumpet".

decisions.choice: a trombeta (L, R); o chifre de carneiro (B)
decisions.reason: The book-wide wording of 1 Samuel 13:3 in Portuguese for the shofar: "trombeta" at Literal and Readable, "chifre de carneiro" at Balanced.

source.text: וְהָיָה֙ אֲר֣וֹן יְהוָ֔ה בָּ֖א עִ֣יר דָּוִ֑ד וּמִיכַ֨ל בַּת־שָׁא֜וּל נִשְׁקְפָ֣ה׀בְּעַ֣ד הַחַלּ֗וֹן וַתֵּ֨רֶא אֶת־הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ דָּוִד֙ מְפַזֵּ֤ז וּמְכַרְכֵּר֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וַתִּ֥בֶז ל֖וֹ בְּלִבָּֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was, [the] ark of Yahweh [was] coming [into the] city of David, and Michal [the] daughter of Saul looked down through the window and saw the king David leaping and whirling before Yahweh, and she despised him in her heart.

en.L: And it happened, [as] the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} came [into the] city of David, Michal the daughter of Saul looked down through the window and saw King David leaping and whirling before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and she despised him in her heart.
