en.B: As the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} was coming into the city of David, Michal the daughter of Saul looked down from the window. She saw King David leaping and dancing before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and in her heart she despised him.
en.R: As the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} was coming into the city of David, Saul's daughter Michal looked out of a window. She saw King David jumping and dancing in front of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and in her heart she despised him.

es.L: Y sucedió [que], cuando el arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} entraba [en la] ciudad de David, Mical la hija de Saúl miró por la ventana y vio al rey David saltando y girando delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y lo despreció en su corazón.
es.B: Cuando el arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} entraba en la ciudad de David, Mical, la hija de Saúl, miró desde la ventana. Vio al rey David saltando y danzando delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y en su corazón lo despreció.
es.R: Cuando el arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} entraba en la ciudad de David, Mical, la hija de Saúl, se asomó a una ventana. Vio al rey David saltando y bailando delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y en su corazón lo despreció.

fr.L: Et il arriva, [comme] l’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} entrait [dans la] cité de David, que Mikal, la fille de Saül, regarda par la fenêtre et vit le roi David sauter et tournoyer devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et elle le méprisa dans son cœur.
fr.B: Comme l’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} entrait dans la cité de David, Mikal, la fille de Saül, regarda par la fenêtre. Elle vit le roi David sauter et danser devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et dans son cœur elle le méprisa.
fr.R: Quand l’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} est entrée dans la cité de David, Mikal, la fille de Saül, regardait par une fenêtre. Elle a vu le roi David sauter et danser devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et dans son cœur elle l’a méprisé.

sw.L: Ikawa sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} lilipokuwa likiingia [katika] mji wa Daudi, Mikali binti Sauli akachungulia dirishani, akamwona mfalme Daudi akirukaruka na kuzunguka-zunguka mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, akamdharau moyoni mwake.
sw.B: Sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} lilipokuwa likiingia katika mji wa Daudi, Mikali binti Sauli alichungulia dirishani. Akamwona mfalme Daudi akirukaruka na kucheza mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, naye akamdharau moyoni mwake.
sw.R: Sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} lilipokuwa likiingia katika mji wa Daudi, Mikali binti Sauli alichungulia dirishani. Akamwona mfalme Daudi akiruka na kucheza mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, naye akamdharau moyoni mwake.

vi.L: Khi hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} vào thành Đa-vít, Mi-canh con gái Sau-lơ nhìn qua cửa sổ, thấy vua Đa-vít nhảy nhót và quay cuồng trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, thì trong lòng khinh bỉ ông.
vi.B: Khi hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đang vào thành Đa-vít, Mi-canh con gái Sau-lơ nhìn xuống qua cửa sổ. Bà thấy vua Đa-vít nhảy nhót múa may trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và trong lòng bà khinh bỉ ông.
vi.R: Khi hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đang vào thành Đa-vít, Mi-canh, con gái Sau-lơ, nhìn ra cửa sổ. Bà thấy vua Đa-vít nhảy nhót múa may trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và trong lòng bà khinh thường ông.

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤가 다윗 성으로 들어올 때, 사울의 딸 미갈이 창문으로 내려다보다가 다윗 왕이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 뛰며 빙빙 돌며 춤추는 것을 보았다. 그리고 그 여자가 마음속으로 그를 업신여겼다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤가 다윗 성으로 들어올 때, 사울의 딸 미갈이 창문으로 내려다보았다. 그 여자는 다윗 왕이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 뛰놀며 춤추는 것을 보고 마음속으로 그를 업신여겼다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤가 다윗 성으로 들어올 때, 사울의 딸 미갈이 창밖을 내다보았다. 미갈은 다윗 왕이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 펄쩍펄쩍 뛰며 춤추는 것을 보고 속으로 그를 업신여겼다.

pt.L: E aconteceu [que, quando] a arca {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} entrava [na] Cidade de Davi, Mical, a filha de Saul, olhou pela janela e viu o rei Davi saltando e rodopiando diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, e o desprezou no seu coração.
pt.B: Quando a arca {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} estava entrando na Cidade de Davi, Mical, filha de Saul, olhou pela janela. Ela viu o rei Davi saltando e dançando diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, e no seu coração o desprezou.
pt.R: Quando a arca {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} estava entrando na Cidade de Davi, Mical, filha de Saul, olhou por uma janela. Ela viu o rei Davi pulando e dançando diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, e no seu coração sentiu desprezo por ele.

decisions.choice: Michal the daughter of Saul: named by her father, not as David's wife
decisions.reason: Michal was David's first wife (1 Samuel 18:27), taken from him by Saul and given back to him (3:13-16). Here and in verses 20 and 23 the writer calls her "the daughter of Saul", which points to the house of Saul that the LORD had set aside for David (verse 21).

decisions.choice: despised him: looked on him with contempt
decisions.reason: The verb means to count someone as worthless. It is used of the men who despised Saul at his choosing (1 Samuel 10:27) and of Goliath despising David (1 Samuel 17:42).

decisions.choice: leaping and whirling
decisions.reason: The first verb means to leap or spring; the second is the whirling dance of verse 14.

decisions.choice: dancing
decisions.reason: As in verse 14.

decisions.choice: o desprezou (L, B); sentiu desprezo por ele (R)
decisions.reason: Michal's scorn is "desprezar", counting him worthless (m2), the verb of 1 Samuel 10:27 and 17:42; "zombar" would be an act she does only in verse 20. "Mical" as for the whole of 1 Samuel.

source.text: וַיָּבִ֜אוּ אֶת־אֲר֣וֹן יְהוָ֗ה וַיַּצִּ֤גוּ אֹתוֹ֙ בִּמְקוֹמ֔וֹ בְּת֣וֹךְ הָאֹ֔הֶל אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָטָה־ל֖וֹ דָּוִ֑ד וַיַּ֨עַל דָּוִ֥ד עֹל֛וֹת לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה וּשְׁלָמִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And they brought [the] ark of Yahweh and set it in its place in [the] midst of the tent that pitched for it David; and offered up David burnt offerings before Yahweh and peace offerings.

en.L: And they brought in the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and set it in its place inside the tent that David had pitched for it; and David offered burnt offerings before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and peace offerings.
en.B: They carried the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in and set it in its place within the tent David had pitched for it. David then offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: They brought the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} into the tent David had set up for it, and put it in its place there. Then David offered burnt offerings and peace offerings to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y metieron el arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y la pusieron en su lugar dentro de la tienda que David había levantado para ella; y ofreció David holocaustos delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y sacrificios de paz.
es.B: Metieron el arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y la colocaron en su lugar dentro de la tienda que David había levantado para ella. Luego David ofreció holocaustos y sacrificios de paz delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Llevaron el arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} a la tienda que David había preparado para ella, y la pusieron allí en su lugar. Luego David le ofreció {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} holocaustos y sacrificios de paz.

fr.L: Et ils amenèrent l’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et la placèrent à sa place, au milieu de la tente que David avait dressée pour elle ; et David offrit des holocaustes devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et des sacrifices de communion.
fr.B: On fit entrer l’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et on la plaça à sa place, sous la tente que David avait dressée pour elle. Puis David offrit des holocaustes et des sacrifices de communion devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: On a apporté l’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} dans la tente que David avait montée pour elle, et on l’a mise à sa place. Ensuite David a offert des holocaustes et des sacrifices de communion {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Wakaliingiza sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wakaliweka mahali pake ndani ya hema ambalo Daudi alikuwa amelipigia; naye Daudi akatoa sadaka za kuteketezwa mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na sadaka za amani.
sw.B: Waliliingiza sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wakaliweka mahali pake ndani ya hema ambalo Daudi alikuwa amelipigia. Kisha Daudi akatoa sadaka za kuteketezwa na sadaka za amani mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Walilileta sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ndani ya hema ambalo Daudi alikuwa amelisimamisha kwa ajili yake, wakaliweka mahali pake. Kisha Daudi akamtolea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} sadaka za kuteketezwa na sadaka za amani.

vi.L: Họ đem hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} vào và đặt tại chỗ của nó, ở giữa cái lều mà Đa-vít đã dựng cho nó; rồi Đa-vít dâng các của lễ thiêu trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, cùng các tế lễ bình an.
vi.B: Họ khiêng hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} vào và đặt tại chỗ của nó trong cái lều Đa-vít đã dựng cho nó. Rồi Đa-vít dâng các của lễ thiêu và tế lễ bình an trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Họ đem hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} vào cái lều Đa-vít đã dựng cho nó, và đặt vào chỗ của nó ở đó. Rồi Đa-vít dâng các của lễ thiêu và tế lễ bình an lên {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤를 가지고 들어와서, 다윗이 그것을 위하여 쳐 놓은 장막 한가운데 그 자리에 놓았다. 그리고 다윗이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 번제와 화목제를 드렸다.
ko.B: 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤를 메고 들어가서, 다윗이 그것을 위해 쳐 놓은 장막 안 제자리에 놓았다. 그리고 다윗이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에 번제와 화목제를 드렸다.
ko.R: 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤를 다윗이 마련해 둔 장막 안으로 메고 들어가 제자리에 놓았다. 그리고 다윗은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 번제와 화목제를 드렸다.

pt.L: E trouxeram a arca {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e a colocaram no seu lugar, no meio da tenda que Davi tinha armado para ela; e Davi ofereceu holocaustos diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, e sacrifícios de comunhão.
pt.B: Eles levaram para dentro a arca {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e a colocaram no seu lugar, na tenda que Davi tinha armado para ela. Depois Davi ofereceu holocaustos e sacrifícios de comunhão diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.R: Eles levaram a arca {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} para dentro da tenda que Davi tinha armado para ela, e a puseram no seu lugar ali. Depois Davi ofereceu holocaustos e sacrifícios de comunhão {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}.

decisions.choice: the tent David had pitched: a new tent in Jerusalem
decisions.reason: This was a tent David set up for the ark in his city, not the old tent of meeting, which 1 Chronicles 16:39 and 21:29 place at Gibeon. The ark stays in a tent until the temple is built (7:2, 6).

decisions.choice: burnt offerings and peace offerings
decisions.reason: A burnt offering was burned whole on the altar as a gift to God (Leviticus 1). Most of a peace offering was eaten by the worshipers in a shared meal (Leviticus 3; 7:11-15), which explains the food given out in verse 19.

decisions.choice: David offered: the king brought the offerings
decisions.reason: The king is named as the one who offered, as Solomon is later (1 Kings 8:62-64). The text does not say whether priests did the work at the altar for him.

decisions.choice: offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the LORD
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable put the two kinds of offering together; Readable says "to the LORD" for "before the LORD".

decisions.choice: des holocaustes; des sacrifices de communion
alternatives: des offrandes brûlées; des sacrifices de paix
decisions.reason: As the Pentateuch terms list sets for the burnt offering and the peace offering, so that the offerings keep the names they have in the law.

decisions.choice: "holocaustos", "sacrificios de paz"
decisions.reason: As the Pentateuch terms list sets for the burnt offering and the peace offering (shelamim), at every level.

decisions.choice: "của lễ thiêu", "tế lễ bình an"
decisions.reason: The Genesis note's term for the burnt offering, and the usual Vietnamese name for the peace offering, kept through the book.

decisions.choice: "번제" and "화목제" for the burnt offerings and peace offerings
decisions.reason: The established Korean names of the two offerings; the English keeps the offerings' names at every level too.

source.text: וַיְכַ֣ל דָּוִ֔ד מֵהַעֲל֥וֹת הָעוֹלָ֖ה וְהַשְּׁלָמִ֑ים וַיְבָ֣רֶךְ אֶת־הָעָ֔ם בְּשֵׁ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: And finished David from offering up the burnt offering and the peace offerings, and he blessed the people in [the] name of Yahweh of hosts.

en.L: And David finished offering the burnt offering and the peace offerings, and he blessed the people in the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts.
en.B: When David had finished offering the burnt offerings and the peace offerings, he pronounced a blessing on the people in the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies.
en.R: When David was done with the burnt offerings and peace offerings, he spoke a blessing over the people in the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies.

es.L: Y terminó David de ofrecer el holocausto y los sacrificios de paz, y bendijo al pueblo en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} de los ejércitos.
es.B: Cuando David terminó de ofrecer los holocaustos y los sacrificios de paz, pronunció una bendición sobre el pueblo en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos.
es.R: Cuando David terminó con los holocaustos y los sacrificios de paz, bendijo al pueblo en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos.

fr.L: Et David acheva d’offrir l’holocauste et les sacrifices de communion, et il bénit le peuple au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} des armées.
fr.B: Quand David eut fini d’offrir les holocaustes et les sacrifices de communion, il bénit le peuple au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} des armées.
fr.R: Quand David a eu fini d’offrir les holocaustes et les sacrifices de communion, il a prononcé une bénédiction sur le peuple au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} des armées.

sw.L: Daudi akamaliza kutoa sadaka ya kuteketezwa na sadaka za amani, akawabariki watu kwa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi.
sw.B: Daudi alipomaliza kutoa sadaka za kuteketezwa na sadaka za amani, aliwabariki watu kwa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi.
sw.R: Daudi alipomaliza kutoa sadaka za kuteketezwa na sadaka za amani, alitamka baraka juu ya watu kwa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi.

vi.L: Khi Đa-vít đã dâng xong của lễ thiêu và các tế lễ bình an, ông chúc phước cho dân trong danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân.
vi.B: Khi Đa-vít đã dâng xong các của lễ thiêu và tế lễ bình an, ông nhân danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân chúc phước cho dân chúng.
vi.R: Khi Đa-vít đã dâng xong các của lễ thiêu và tế lễ bình an, ông nhân danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân chúc phước cho dân chúng.

ko.L: 그리고 다윗이 번제와 화목제 드리기를 마치고, 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름으로 백성에게 복을 빌어 주었다.
ko.B: 다윗은 번제와 화목제를 다 드린 뒤에, 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름으로 백성에게 복을 빌어 주었다.
ko.R: 다윗은 번제와 화목제를 다 드리고 나서, 하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름으로 백성에게 복을 빌어 주었다.

pt.L: E Davi acabou de oferecer o holocausto e os sacrifícios de comunhão, e abençoou o povo em nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} dos Exércitos.
pt.B: Quando Davi terminou de oferecer os holocaustos e os sacrifícios de comunhão, abençoou o povo em nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} dos Exércitos.
pt.R: Quando Davi terminou de oferecer os holocaustos e os sacrifícios de comunhão, ele pronunciou uma bênção sobre o povo em nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} dos Exércitos.

decisions.choice: the burnt offering: all the burnt offerings
decisions.reason: The singular stands for the whole group of burnt offerings named in verse 17.

decisions.choice: blessed the people in the name of the LORD of hosts
decisions.reason: To bless in the LORD's name is to call down his good on people, speaking for him (Numbers 6:23-27). David does this as king leading the worship, as Solomon does when the temple is dedicated (1 Kings 8:14, 55). The full title of verse 2 returns at the close of the procession.

decisions.choice: the LORD of Armies
decisions.reason: As in verse 2.

source.text: וַיְחַלֵּ֨ק לְכָל־הָעָ֜ם לְכָל־הֲמ֣וֹן יִשְׂרָאֵל֮ לְמֵאִ֣ישׁ וְעַד־אִשָּׁה֒ לְאִ֗ישׁ חַלַּ֥ת לֶ֨חֶם֙ אַחַ֔ת וְאֶשְׁפָּ֣ר אֶחָ֔ד וַאֲשִׁישָׁ֖ה אֶחָ֑ת וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ כָּל־הָעָ֖ם אִ֥ישׁ לְבֵיתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he distributed to all the people, to all [the] multitude of Israel, from man and to woman, to each cake of bread one and date-cake one and raisin-cake one; and went all the people, each to his house.

en.L: And he distributed to all the people, to all the crowd of Israel, from man to woman, to each one cake of bread and one date cake and one raisin cake. And all the people went, each to {{gender:their|his}} house.
en.B: He also handed out food to all the people, the whole crowd of Israel, both men and women: a loaf of bread, a cake of dates and a cake of raisins for each one. Then all the people went home, each to {{gender:their|his}} own house.
en.R: He gave food to every person in the crowd of Israel, both men and women. Each one received a loaf of bread, a cake of dates and a cake of raisins. Then everyone went home.

es.L: Y repartió a todo el pueblo, a toda la multitud de Israel, desde el hombre hasta la mujer, a cada uno una torta de pan y una torta de dátiles y una torta de pasas. Y se fue todo el pueblo, cada cual a su casa.
es.B: También repartió comida a todo el pueblo, a toda la multitud de Israel, tanto a hombres como a mujeres: un pan, una torta de dátiles y una torta de pasas para cada uno. Luego todo el pueblo se fue, cada cual a su propia casa.
es.R: Les dio comida a todas las personas de la multitud de Israel, tanto hombres como mujeres. Cada uno recibió un pan, una torta de dátiles y una torta de pasas. Después todos se fueron a su casa.

fr.L: Et il distribua à tout le peuple, à toute la foule d’Israël, de l’homme à la femme, à chacun une galette de pain, un gâteau de dattes et un gâteau de raisins. Et tout le peuple s’en alla, chacun dans sa maison.
fr.B: Il distribua aussi à tout le peuple, à toute la foule d’Israël, hommes et femmes, un pain, un gâteau de dattes et un gâteau de raisins secs pour chacun. Puis tout le peuple rentra, chacun chez soi.
fr.R: Il a donné de la nourriture à toutes les personnes de la foule d’Israël, hommes et femmes. Chacun a reçu un pain, un gâteau de dattes et un gâteau de raisins secs. Ensuite tout le monde est rentré à la maison.

sw.L: Akawagawia watu wote, umati wote wa Israeli, tangu mwanamume hata mwanamke, kila mmoja mkate mmoja na andazi moja la tende na andazi moja la zabibu kavu. Watu wote wakaenda, kila mtu nyumbani kwake.
sw.B: Aliwagawia pia watu wote chakula, umati wote wa Israeli, wanaume na wanawake: kila mmoja mkate mmoja, andazi la tende na andazi la zabibu kavu. Kisha watu wote wakaenda, kila mtu nyumbani kwake.
sw.R: Aliwapa chakula watu wote katika umati wa Israeli, wanaume na wanawake. Kila mmoja alipata mkate mmoja, andazi la tende na andazi la zabibu kavu. Kisha kila mtu akarudi nyumbani.

vi.L: Ông phân phát cho toàn dân, cho cả đoàn dân đông Y-sơ-ra-ên, từ người nam đến người nữ, mỗi người một ổ bánh, một bánh chà là và một bánh nho khô. Rồi toàn dân ai nấy đều về nhà mình.
vi.B: Ông cũng phân phát thức ăn cho toàn dân, cho cả đoàn dân Y-sơ-ra-ên, cả nam lẫn nữ: mỗi người một ổ bánh, một bánh chà là và một bánh nho khô. Rồi toàn dân ai nấy đều trở về nhà mình.
vi.R: Ông phát thức ăn cho từng người trong đoàn dân Y-sơ-ra-ên, cả đàn ông lẫn đàn bà. Mỗi người nhận được một ổ bánh, một bánh chà là và một bánh nho khô. Rồi mọi người trở về nhà.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 모든 백성, 곧 이스라엘의 온 무리에게 남자에서 여자까지 각 사람에게 빵 한 덩이와 대추야자 과자 하나와 건포도 과자 하나를 나누어 주었다. 그리고 모든 백성이 저마다 자기 집으로 갔다.
ko.B: 그는 모든 백성, 곧 이스라엘의 온 무리에게 남자든 여자든 각 사람에게 빵 한 덩이와 대추야자 과자 하나와 건포도 과자 하나씩을 나누어 주었다. 그러고 나서 모든 백성은 저마다 자기 집으로 돌아갔다.
ko.R: 그는 이스라엘 무리 가운데 남자든 여자든 모든 사람에게 음식을 나누어 주었다. 사람마다 빵 한 덩이와 대추야자 과자 하나와 건포도 과자 하나를 받았다. 그러고 나서 모두 집으로 돌아갔다.

pt.L: E repartiu a todo o povo, a toda a multidão de Israel, desde o homem até a mulher, a cada um um bolo de pão, e um bolo de tâmaras, e um bolo de passas. E todo o povo foi, cada um para a sua casa.
pt.B: Ele também distribuiu comida a todo o povo, a toda a multidão de Israel, homens e mulheres: um pão, um bolo de tâmaras e um bolo de passas para cada um. Depois todo o povo foi embora, cada um para a sua casa.
pt.R: Ele deu comida a todas as pessoas da multidão de Israel, homens e mulheres. Cada um recebeu um pão, um bolo de tâmaras e um bolo de passas. Depois todos voltaram para casa.

decisions.choice: to the whole crowd, men and women: a feast for all
decisions.reason: Women as well as men were given a share. The meal belonged with the peace offerings (verse 17), a feast of joy before the LORD.

decisions.choice: a cake of bread; a raisin cake
decisions.reason: The first is a round loaf, sometimes ring-shaped. The raisin cake was made of pressed dried grapes and was festival food (Hosea 3:1; Song of Songs 2:5).

decisions.choice: a date cake: meaning uncertain
decisions.reason: The word is found only here and in the same account at 1 Chronicles 16:3, and its meaning is not known for certain. It may be a cake of dates, or a portion of meat from the sacrifices; older guesses include a measure of wine.

decisions.choice: a loaf of bread
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "loaf" for "cake of bread", the ordinary English word for a single bread.

decisions.choice: each to their house
decisions.reason: The people are men and women, so the inclusive form is the default and "his" the alternative. Readable says "everyone", which needs no setting.

decisions.choice: chacun dans sa maison (L), chacun chez soi (B), no gender span
alternatives: a gender span as in the English
decisions.reason: French "chacun ... sa maison" already covers men and women, so French needs no gender setting where the English has "their|his"; the French style guide puts no span on generic pronouns.

decisions.choice: "cada cual a su casa", with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English gender span ("their" / "his") has no Spanish counterpart: "su casa" serves for either, and "cada cual" already takes in men and women.

decisions.choice: kila mtu nyumbani kwake
decisions.reason: The English has a gender span on "their|his". "Kila mtu nyumbani kwake" already includes men and women, and Swahili "-ake" has no gender, so there is no span here.

decisions.choice: "ai nấy đều về nhà mình", with no gender setting
decisions.reason: The English offers "their" or "his"; Vietnamese "ai nấy" and "mình" already include men and women, so there is no second wording.

decisions.choice: "bánh chà là"
decisions.reason: The word's meaning is uncertain (meaning decision); Vietnamese follows the English reading.

decisions.choice: No gender span: "저마다 자기 집으로"
alternatives: a gender span as in the English
decisions.reason: Korean "자기" and "저마다" already include men and women, so the English setting has nothing to change.

decisions.choice: cada um para a sua casa (no gender setting)
alternatives: cada um para a casa dele
decisions.reason: Portuguese "cada um" and "a sua casa" already take in men and women, so there is no second wording for the English gender setting. "Bolo de tâmaras" follows the English for the uncertain word (m3).

source.text: וַיָּ֥שָׁב דָּוִ֖ד לְבָרֵ֣ךְ אֶת־בֵּית֑וֹ וַתֵּצֵ֞א מִיכַ֤ל בַּת־שָׁאוּל֙ לִקְרַ֣את דָּוִ֔ד וַתֹּ֗אמֶר מַה־נִּכְבַּ֨ד הַיּ֜וֹם מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִגְלָ֤ה הַיּוֹם֙ לְעֵינֵ֨י אַמְה֣וֹת עֲבָדָ֔יו כְּהִגָּל֥וֹת נִגְל֖וֹת אַחַ֥ד הָרֵקִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And returned David to bless his household; and came out Michal [the] daughter of Saul to meet David and said, How honored himself today [the] king of Israel, who uncovered himself today in [the] eyes of [the] maidservants of his servants, as uncovers himself shamelessly one of the worthless [men]!

en.L: And David returned to bless his household, and Michal the daughter of Saul came out to meet David and said, "How the king of Israel honored himself today, who uncovered himself today in the eyes of the slave girls of his servants, as one of the worthless [men] shamelessly uncovers himself!"
en.B: When David returned home to bless his household, Saul's daughter Michal came out to meet him. She said, "How the king of Israel has honored himself today! He has uncovered himself today before the eyes of his officials' servant girls, as shamelessly as some worthless fellow would!"
en.R: When David went home to bless his family, Michal, Saul's daughter, came out to meet him. She said, "What honor the king of Israel won for himself today! He uncovered his body in front of the servant girls of his officials, as shamelessly as any worthless fellow!"

es.L: Y volvió David para bendecir a su casa, y Mical la hija de Saúl salió al encuentro de David y dijo: «¡Qué honrado se ha hecho hoy el rey de Israel, que se ha descubierto hoy a los ojos de las esclavas de sus siervos, como se descubre sin pudor uno de los [hombres] despreciables!».
es.B: Cuando David regresó para bendecir a su familia, Mical, la hija de Saúl, salió a su encuentro. Le dijo: «¡Qué honra se ha dado hoy el rey de Israel! Hoy se ha descubierto a la vista de las criadas de sus oficiales, tan sin vergüenza como lo haría cualquier hombre vulgar».
es.R: Cuando David volvió a su casa para bendecir a su familia, Mical, la hija de Saúl, salió a recibirlo. Le dijo: «¡Qué honra se ganó hoy el rey de Israel! Dejó su cuerpo al descubierto delante de las criadas de sus oficiales, tan sin vergüenza como cualquier hombre vulgar».

fr.L: Et David revint pour bénir sa maison, et Mikal, la fille de Saül, sortit à la rencontre de David et dit : « Comme il s’est honoré aujourd’hui, le roi d’Israël, qui s’est découvert aujourd’hui aux yeux des servantes de ses serviteurs, comme se découvre sans pudeur un homme de rien ! »
fr.B: Quand David rentra pour bénir sa famille, Mikal, la fille de Saül, sortit à sa rencontre. Elle lui dit : « Quel honneur s’est fait aujourd’hui le roi d’Israël ! Il s’est découvert aujourd’hui sous les yeux des servantes de ses officiers, sans plus de pudeur qu’un vaurien ! »
fr.R: Quand David est rentré chez lui pour bénir sa famille, Mikal, la fille de Saül, est sortie à sa rencontre. Elle lui a dit : « Le roi d’Israël s’est vraiment couvert de gloire aujourd’hui ! Il s’est montré à moitié nu devant les servantes de ses officiers, sans aucune honte, comme le premier vaurien venu ! »

sw.L: Daudi akarudi kuibariki nyumba yake, naye Mikali binti Sauli akatoka kumlaki Daudi, akasema, "Jinsi mfalme wa Israeli alivyojitukuza leo, aliyejifunua leo machoni pa vijakazi wa watumishi wake, kama mmoja wa watu wasiofaa kitu ajifunuavyo bila haya!"
sw.B: Daudi aliporudi nyumbani kuibariki jamaa yake, Mikali binti Sauli alitoka kumlaki. Akasema, "Jinsi mfalme wa Israeli alivyojipatia heshima leo! Amejifunua leo mbele ya macho ya wajakazi wa maafisa wake, bila haya, kama mtu yeyote asiyefaa kitu!"
sw.R: Daudi aliporudi nyumbani kuibariki jamaa yake, Mikali binti Sauli alitoka kumlaki. Akasema, "Mfalme wa Israeli amejipatia heshima kubwa kweli leo! Ameuonyesha mwili wake mbele ya wajakazi wa maafisa wake, bila haya kama mtu yeyote asiyefaa kitu!"

vi.L: Đa-vít trở về để chúc phước cho nhà mình. Mi-canh con gái Sau-lơ ra đón Đa-vít và nói: "Hôm nay vua Y-sơ-ra-ên thật vinh hiển làm sao, là người hôm nay đã tự phơi mình trước mắt các tớ gái của các đầy tớ mình, như một kẻ vô lại trơ trẽn phơi mình ra!"
vi.B: Khi Đa-vít trở về để chúc phước cho gia đình mình, Mi-canh con gái Sau-lơ ra đón ông và nói: "Hôm nay vua Y-sơ-ra-ên thật vẻ vang làm sao! Hôm nay vua đã tự phơi mình trước mắt các tớ gái của quần thần, trơ trẽn như một kẻ vô lại!"
vi.R: Khi Đa-vít về nhà để chúc phước cho gia đình, Mi-canh, con gái Sau-lơ, ra đón ông. Bà nói: "Hôm nay vua Y-sơ-ra-ên thật là vẻ vang quá! Vua đã để lộ thân thể trước mặt các tớ gái của quần thần, trơ trẽn như bất cứ kẻ vô lại nào!"

ko.L: 그리고 다윗이 자기 집안에 복을 빌어 주려고 돌아왔다. 그리고 사울의 딸 미갈이 다윗을 맞으러 나와서 말했다. "이스라엘의 왕이 오늘 참 영광스러웠다. 쓸모없는 자들 가운데 하나가 부끄러움도 없이 자기 몸을 드러내듯이, 오늘 자기 신하들의 여종들 눈앞에서 자기 몸을 드러냈으니!"
ko.B: 다윗이 자기 집안에 복을 빌어 주려고 돌아오자, 사울의 딸 미갈이 다윗을 맞으러 나와서 말했다. "오늘 이스라엘의 왕께서 참 체면을 세우셨군요! 건달 같은 자가 부끄러운 줄도 모르고 몸을 드러내듯이, 오늘 신하들의 여종들이 보는 앞에서 몸을 드러내셨으니 말이에요!"
ko.R: 다윗이 가족에게 복을 빌어 주려고 집으로 돌아오자, 사울의 딸 미갈이 그를 맞으러 나와서 말했다. "오늘 이스라엘의 왕께서 참 대단한 영광을 얻으셨군요! 신하들의 여종들 앞에서 몸을 다 드러내셨으니까요. 부끄러운 줄 모르는 건달처럼 말이에요!"

pt.L: E Davi voltou para abençoar a sua casa, e Mical, a filha de Saul, saiu ao encontro de Davi e disse: "Como se honrou hoje o rei de Israel, que hoje se descobriu aos olhos das escravas dos seus servos, como um dos homens vazios se descobre sem nenhuma vergonha!"
pt.B: Quando Davi voltou para abençoar a sua família, Mical, filha de Saul, saiu ao seu encontro e disse: "Que honra o rei de Israel deu a si mesmo hoje! Ele se expôs hoje diante dos olhos das servas dos seus oficiais, sem nenhuma vergonha, como faria um homem qualquer, sem valor!"
pt.R: Quando Davi foi para casa abençoar a família, Mical, filha de Saul, saiu para encontrá-lo. Ela disse: "Que honra o rei de Israel ganhou hoje! Ele mostrou o corpo na frente das servas dos seus oficiais, sem nenhuma vergonha, como qualquer homem à toa!"

decisions.choice: How the king of Israel honored himself today!: bitter mockery
decisions.reason: Michal says the opposite of what she means: in her eyes the king has disgraced himself. The word "honor" is taken up again by David in verse 22, where he says he will be honored by the very women she speaks of.

decisions.choice: uncovered himself: exposed his body
decisions.reason: The verb means "uncover, lay bare", and the repeated form stresses it. Dancing hard in a short linen ephod (verse 14), David showed more of his body than she thought fitting for a king. The text does not say he was naked.

decisions.choice: one of the worthless men: a low, good-for-nothing fellow
decisions.reason: The word means "empty" and is used of reckless, worthless men (Judges 9:4; 11:3).

decisions.choice: the slave girls of his servants: the lowest women in the city
decisions.reason: These are female slaves belonging to the king's officials. Michal, a king's daughter, sets them against the dignity of the king.

decisions.choice: servant girls; officials
decisions.reason: As elsewhere, Literal says "slave" and Balanced and Readable "servant" for these women; the king's "servants" are his officials, as in these books.

decisions.choice: uncovered his body
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what "uncovered himself" means, without going beyond it.

decisions.choice: les servantes de ses serviteurs (L); les servantes de ses officiers (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Servantes" at every level reads naturally for female slaves in a household; the king's servants are "officiers" at Balanced and Readable, as set for these books.

decisions.choice: "las esclavas de sus siervos" (L); "las criadas de sus oficiales" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the English levels: Literal keeps "esclavas" for the slave girls, and Balanced and Readable say "criadas"; the king's servants are his officials at Balanced and Readable, as the Samuel terms note sets.

decisions.choice: vijakazi (Literal); wajakazi (Balanced, Readable); watumishi / maafisa
decisions.reason: "Kijakazi" is a slave girl, as the English Literal "slave girls"; Balanced and Readable say "wajakazi" (maidservants). The king's servants are "watumishi" at Literal and "maafisa" at Balanced and Readable, as set for Samuel.

decisions.choice: Michal speaks of David as "vua Y-sơ-ra-ên" in the third person, not to him as "anh"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew mocks him in the third person (meaning decision); Vietnamese keeps the cold distance, which avoids any form of address between husband and wife.

decisions.choice: Michal and David speak in the polite style (해요체) at Balanced and Readable, the plain style at Literal; Michal's mocking honorifics for "the king of Israel" carry her sarcasm
decisions.reason: As the Genesis terms note sets for husband and wife; Michal speaks of David in the third person as "the king", and Korean honorifics used in scorn make the irony plain.

decisions.choice: Como se honrou ... (L); Que honra ... deu a si mesmo (B, R); escravas (L), servas (B, R)
decisions.reason: Michal's mockery says the opposite of what she means (m1), so Portuguese keeps the word "honra" that David takes up in verse 22 ("serei honrado"), rather than saying "vergonha" outright. The women are "escravas" at Literal and "servas" at Balanced and Readable, as the book-wide rule for the word, and "servos" are the king's "oficiais" (B, R), as the English. Michal speaks of the king in the third person, so no form of address is needed.

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִד֮ אֶל־מִיכַל֒ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר בָּֽחַר־בִּ֤י מֵֽאָבִיךְ֙ וּמִכָּל־בֵּית֔וֹ לְצַוֺּ֨ת אֹתִ֥י נָגִ֛יד עַל־עַ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְשִׂחַקְתִּ֖י לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And said David to Michal, Before Yahweh, who chose me over your father and over all his house to appoint me ruler over [the] people of Yahweh, over Israel, and I will celebrate before Yahweh.

en.L: And David said to Michal, "Before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, who chose me over your father and over all his house to appoint me ruler over the people of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, over Israel, I will celebrate before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: David said to Michal, "It was before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} that I danced, before the one who chose me over your father and over all his family and appointed me ruler over Israel, the people of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. I will celebrate before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: David answered Michal, "I was dancing for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. He chose me instead of your father or anyone in his family. He made me the leader of Israel, the people of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. So I will celebrate in front of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y dijo David a Mical: «Delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, que me escogió en lugar de tu padre y de toda su casa para constituirme gobernante sobre el pueblo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, sobre Israel, delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} me regocijaré.
es.B: David le dijo a Mical: «Fue delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} que yo danzaba, delante de quien me escogió en lugar de tu padre y de toda su familia, y me nombró gobernante sobre Israel, el pueblo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Celebraré delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: David le respondió a Mical: «Yo bailaba para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Él me escogió a mí en lugar de tu padre o de cualquiera de su familia. Me hizo líder de Israel, el pueblo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Por eso celebraré delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et David dit à Mikal : « Devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, qui m’a choisi de préférence à ton père et à toute sa maison pour m’établir chef sur le peuple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, sur Israël, je m’égaierai devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: David répondit à Mikal : « C’est devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} que j’ai dansé, devant celui qui m’a choisi de préférence à ton père et à toute sa famille pour m’établir chef d’Israël, le peuple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Je me réjouirai devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: David a répondu à Mikal : « C’est pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} que je dansais. Il m’a choisi à la place de ton père et de toute sa famille. Il a fait de moi le chef d’Israël, le peuple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Alors je ferai la fête devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Daudi akamwambia Mikali, "Mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, aliyenichagua mimi kuliko baba yako na kuliko nyumba yake yote ili aniweke kuwa kiongozi juu ya watu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, juu ya Israeli, nitashangilia mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Daudi akamwambia Mikali, "Nilicheza mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, aliyenichagua kuliko baba yako na jamaa yake yote, akaniweka kuwa kiongozi juu ya Israeli, watu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Nitashangilia mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Daudi akamjibu Mikali, "Nilikuwa nikicheza kwa ajili ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Yeye alinichagua mimi badala ya baba yako au mtu yeyote wa jamaa yake. Alinifanya kiongozi wa Israeli, watu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Kwa hiyo nitashangilia mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Đa-vít nói với Mi-canh: "[Ấy là] trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đấng đã chọn ta thay vì cha bà và cả nhà người, để lập ta làm người lãnh đạo dân của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, tức là Y-sơ-ra-ên, ta sẽ nhảy múa vui mừng trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Đa-vít đáp với Mi-canh: "Ta đã nhảy múa trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đấng đã chọn ta thay vì cha bà và cả gia đình người, và lập ta làm người lãnh đạo Y-sơ-ra-ên, dân của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Ta sẽ còn vui mừng trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Đa-vít trả lời Mi-canh: "Ta nhảy múa là để tôn vinh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Ngài đã chọn ta thay vì cha bà hay bất cứ ai trong gia đình người. Ngài đã lập ta làm người lãnh đạo Y-sơ-ra-ên, dân của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Vậy ta sẽ còn vui mừng trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 그러자 다윗이 미갈에게 말했다. "너의 아버지와 그의 온 집안을 제치고 나를 택하셔서 나를 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 백성 이스라엘 위에 지도자로 세우신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서, 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 즐거워할 것이다.
ko.B: 다윗이 미갈에게 말했다. "내가 춤춘 것은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서였어요. 그분은 당신의 아버지와 그 온 집안을 제쳐 두고 나를 택하셔서, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 백성 이스라엘의 지도자로 세우셨어요. 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 계속 즐거워할 거예요.
ko.R: 다윗이 미갈에게 대답했다. "나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 위해 춤을 춘 거예요. 그분은 당신의 아버지나 그 집안의 누구도 아닌 나를 택하셨어요. 그분이 나를 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 백성 이스라엘의 지도자로 세우셨어요. 그러니 나는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 즐거워할 거예요.

pt.L: E Davi disse a Mical: "Diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, que me escolheu em lugar do seu pai e de toda a casa dele para me estabelecer como príncipe sobre o povo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, sobre Israel, eu celebrarei diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.B: Davi respondeu a Mical: "Foi diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} que eu dancei, diante daquele que me escolheu em lugar do seu pai e de toda a família dele e me nomeou príncipe sobre Israel, o povo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. Eu vou celebrar diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.R: Davi respondeu a Mical: "Eu estava dançando para {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. Ele me escolheu em vez do seu pai ou de qualquer pessoa da família dele. Ele me fez chefe de Israel, o povo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. Por isso vou fazer festa diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.

decisions.choice: Before the LORD ...: it was before the LORD that I did it
alternatives: Before the LORD I danced; blessed be the LORD, who chose me (the Greek)
decisions.reason: David begins "Before the LORD" and does not finish the thought, then ends with "I will celebrate before the LORD". The sense is: what I did, I did before the LORD. The Greek fills it out: "Before the LORD I danced; blessed be the LORD, who chose me ...". The Hebrew is followed here.

decisions.choice: who chose me over your father and all his house
decisions.reason: David reminds Saul's daughter that the LORD rejected Saul and chose David in his place (1 Samuel 13:13-14; 15:28; 16:1). His dancing was worship of the God who made him king, not a show for others.

decisions.choice: ruler: the one the LORD appoints to lead his people
decisions.reason: The word was used when the LORD chose a man after his own heart to lead his people (1 Samuel 13:14; 25:30).

decisions.choice: celebrate
decisions.reason: The same verb as in verse 5: to make merry, with music and dance.

decisions.choice: It was before the LORD that I danced; I was dancing for the LORD
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable supply "I danced" so that David's unfinished opening reads as a sentence (see m1).

decisions.choice: leader
decisions.reason: Readable says "leader" for the word Literal and Balanced render "ruler", as in these books.

decisions.choice: David says "ta" and "bà" to Michal in this quarrel
decisions.reason: The Genesis note sets "em" and "anh" between husband and wife at Balanced and Readable; here David answers his wife's contempt as king, and the cold "ta" and "bà" carry the break between them that verse 23 seals.

decisions.choice: você (David to Michal): "o seu pai"
decisions.reason: Husband and wife say "você" to each other, as the book-wide rule of 1 Samuel 19:11 in Portuguese; so David says "o seu pai". "Príncipe" (L, B) and "chefe" (R) keep the book-wide word for the leader the LORD appoints (5:2; 1 Samuel 9:16).

source.text: וּנְקַלֹּ֤תִי עוֹד֙ מִזֹּ֔את וְהָיִ֥יתִי שָׁפָ֖ל בְּעֵינָ֑י וְעִם־הָֽאֲמָהוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמַ֔רְתְּ עִמָּ֖ם אִכָּבֵֽדָה׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will be lightly esteemed still more than this, and I will be low in my eyes; and with the maidservants of whom you have spoken, with them I will be honored.

en.L: And I will be more lightly esteemed still than this, and I will be low in my [own] eyes; but with the slave girls of whom you have spoken, with them I will be honored."
en.B: I will make myself even more undignified than this, and I will be humble in my own eyes. But by the servant girls you spoke of, by them I will be held in honor."
en.R: I am willing to look even more foolish than this and to be humble in my own eyes. But those servant girls you talked about will honor me."

es.L: Y seré tenido en menos todavía que esto, y seré bajo a mis [propios] ojos; pero con las esclavas de quienes has hablado, con ellas seré honrado».
es.B: Me rebajaré todavía más que esto, y seré humilde a mis propios ojos. Pero esas criadas de las que hablaste, ellas me tendrán en honra».
es.R: Estoy dispuesto a parecer todavía más tonto que esto y a ser humilde a mis propios ojos. Pero esas criadas de las que hablaste me honrarán».

fr.L: Et je serai encore plus méprisable que cela, et je serai bas à mes [propres] yeux ; mais auprès des servantes dont tu as parlé, auprès d’elles, je serai honoré. »
fr.B: Je m’abaisserai encore plus que cela, et je serai humble à mes propres yeux. Mais ces servantes dont tu parles, elles m’honoreront. »
fr.R: Je suis prêt à paraître encore plus ridicule et à être humble à mes propres yeux. Mais ces servantes dont tu as parlé, elles, m’honoreront. »

sw.L: Nami nitajidharaulisha zaidi kuliko hivi, nami nitakuwa mnyonge machoni pangu; lakini kwa vijakazi hao uliowasema, kwao nitaheshimiwa."
sw.B: Nitajishusha hata zaidi kuliko hivi, nami nitakuwa mnyenyekevu machoni pangu mwenyewe. Lakini wale wajakazi uliowasema, wao ndio watakaoniheshimu."
sw.R: Niko tayari kuonekana mjinga zaidi kuliko hivi na kujinyenyekeza machoni pangu mwenyewe. Lakini wale wajakazi uliowataja wataniheshimu."

vi.L: Ta sẽ còn bị coi rẻ hơn thế nữa, và ta sẽ thấp hèn trong mắt [chính] mình; nhưng với những tớ gái mà bà đã nói, với họ ta sẽ được tôn trọng."
vi.B: Ta sẽ còn hạ mình hơn thế nữa, và tự xem mình là thấp hèn. Nhưng chính những tớ gái bà đã nói đến sẽ tôn trọng ta."

pt.L: E serei ainda mais desprezível do que isto, e serei baixo aos meus [próprios] olhos; mas com as escravas de quem você falou, com elas serei honrado."
pt.B: Eu vou me rebaixar ainda mais do que isso e serei humilde aos meus próprios olhos. Mas por aquelas servas de quem você falou, por elas serei honrado."
pt.R: Estou disposto a parecer ainda mais ridículo do que isso e a ser humilde aos meus próprios olhos. Mas essas servas de quem você falou vão me honrar."

decisions.choice: lightly esteemed ... honored: "light" set against "heavy"
decisions.reason: The verb for "be lightly esteemed" comes from a word for "light, of little weight"; the word for "honor" comes from a word for "heavy, weighty". David answers Michal's mocking "honored" (verse 20): he is ready to be thought of little weight, and it is among the lowly that he will have honor.

decisions.choice: in my own eyes: as the Hebrew text reads
decisions.reason: The Greek reads "in your eyes", which would mean "I will be low in your sight". The Hebrew has David say he will be humble in his own sight.

decisions.choice: low ... honored: the LORD lifts the lowly
decisions.reason: The words echo Hannah's song: the LORD brings low and lifts up, and gives the poor a seat of honor (1 Samuel 2:7-8).

decisions.choice: servant girls
decisions.reason: As in verse 20.

decisions.choice: desprezível, rebaixar ... honrado
decisions.reason: Hebrew sets "light" against "heavy" (m1); Portuguese cannot keep that picture, so it keeps the contrast in sense, "desprezível" or "me rebaixar" against "honrado", which answers Michal's "honrou" in verse 20.

en.B: And Michal the daughter of Saul had no child until the day she died.
en.R: Michal, Saul's daughter, never had any children as long as she lived.

pt.R: Mical, filha de Saul, nunca teve filhos enquanto viveu.

decisions.choice: Michal had no child: Saul's line would not continue through David's house
decisions.reason: The writer does not say whether this was the LORD's judgment or because David no longer lived with her as a husband. Either way, no child of Saul's daughter would sit on David's throne. (In 21:8 the Hebrew names "Michal" as the mother of five sons, but that is probably an error for her sister Merab, as 1 Samuel 18:19 shows.)
